-<p>Under <code>FirstSuccessor</code>, B may hold every acknowledged write when A fails. Once B owns the range, though, C becomes B's first successor. If C is behind, B has to wait for C to catch up and be admitted before writes can succeed again. Otherwise the next acknowledged write would have no protected copy.</p>
-<p>Under <code>OwnerOnly</code>, writes resume as soon as the guards pass, and some recently acknowledged writes may already be gone. Under <code>AllReplicas</code>, every desired copy must be ready. If too few members remain, writes stay blocked until capacity comes back.</p>
-
-<div class="pair">
-  <div><h3>Fencing</h3><p>Fencing stops two owners from serving the same range. A lease covers <code>(node_id, topology_epoch)</code>, and the process-instance ID means a restarted process with empty memory cannot pick up the old instance's authority. GET needs a valid lease too.</p></div>
-  <div><h3>Confirming a failure</h3><p>A single broken link does not say which end has failed. A missing or expired lease is enough to confirm a failure. Otherwise at least two independent nodes must report the member unreachable. If only one pair of nodes disagrees, the affected ranges stay degraded and nobody is evicted.</p></div>
-</div>
-<p>The default lease is five seconds, but that is a fencing parameter. It is <strong>not a five-second failover target</strong>.</p>
-<p class="source"><a href="0001-ha-for-consistent-hash-cache.md#2-owner-leases-and-fencing">Leases</a> · <a href="0001-ha-for-consistent-hash-cache.md#3-failure-suspicion-and-confirmation">Failure confirmation</a> · <a href="0001-ha-for-consistent-hash-cache.md#4-failover">Failover</a></p>
-</section>

-<section id="movement" aria-labelledby="h-movement">
-<div class="sec-head"><span class="sec-num">06</span><h2 id="h-movement">Copies are verified before they are used</h2><span class="time">1 min</span></div>
-<p class="takeaway">Every transition waits for a copy that has been snapshotted, caught up, and verified.</p>
-
-<figure>
-<div class="scroll">
-<svg viewBox="0 0 820 110" role="img" aria-labelledby="f6-title">
-  <title id="f6-title">Snapshot, then catch up, then verify, then admit or stage.</title>
-  <path class="box soft" d="M8,18 H182 L204,55 L182,92 H8 Z"/>
-  <text class="t" x="100" y="52" text-anchor="middle">Snapshot</text>
-  <text class="s" x="100" y="71" text-anchor="middle">copy current data</text>
-  <path class="box soft" d="M210,18 H384 L406,55 L384,92 H210 L232,55 Z"/>
-  <text class="t" x="312" y="52" text-anchor="middle">Catch up</text>
-  <text class="s" x="312" y="71" text-anchor="middle">stream new mutations</text>
-  <path class="box soft" d="M412,18 H586 L608,55 L586,92 H412 L434,55 Z"/>
-  <text class="t" x="514" y="52" text-anchor="middle">Verify</text>
-  <text class="s" x="514" y="71" text-anchor="middle">count, digest, watermark</text>
-  <path class="box ok" d="M614,18 H812 V92 H614 L636,55 Z"/>
-  <text class="t ok" x="722" y="52" text-anchor="middle">Admit or stage</text>
-  <text class="s" x="722" y="71" text-anchor="middle">usable in a transition</text>
-</svg>
-</div>
-</figure>
-
-<div class="table-wrap" role="region" aria-label="Data movement operations" tabindex="0"><table>
-<thead><tr><th>Operation</th><th>What changes</th><th>What must hold before the result is used</th></tr></thead>
-<tbody>
-<tr><td>Scale-out</td><td>New tokens split ranges and add owner and follower duties</td><td>Pause affected writes briefly, drain the last changes, verify, meet the target policy, then commit and activate</td></tr>
-<tr><td>Graceful scale-in</td><td>Removed tokens merge ranges</td><td>Successors cover the merged ranges and downstream followers are ready. Missing data is synced before cutover</td></tr>
-<tr><td>Failure removal</td><td>Ownership moves without help from the failed node</td><td>Old authority is fenced and a surviving admitted copy covers each range. Incomplete copies are not promoted</td></tr>
-<tr><td>Replica repair</td><td>Missing copies are filled in</td><td>Snapshot and incremental history are verified before admission. The topology epoch does not change</td></tr>
-<tr><td>Stronger ACK policy</td><td>More copies become required for success</td><td>Those copies catch up before the stronger policy is committed</td></tr>
-</tbody></table></div>
-
-<p>A graceful scale-in can usually reuse existing replicas instead of copying the owner's whole dataset. Repair still has work to do after a promotion, because the desired follower set shifts. Repair is bounded and resumable. If the topology changes under it, the task's epoch or bounds may no longer match, and it is re-planned.</p>
-<p>A node that was fenced and comes back must rejoin explicitly. It is reset and seeded like a brand-new node. The records it still holds prove nothing.</p>
-<p class="source"><a href="0001-ha-for-consistent-hash-cache.md#membership-and-data-movement">Membership and data movement</a></p>
-</section>
-
-<!-- 7 -->
-<section id="retries" aria-labelledby="h-retries">
-<div class="sec-head"><span class="sec-num">07</span><h2 id="h-retries">Ordering and retries solve different problems</h2><span class="time">2 min</span></div>
-<p class="takeaway">A lost reply must not cause a duplicate write, and a missing replication entry must not go unnoticed.</p>
-
-<p>There are two counters, and they do different jobs:</p>
-<div class="pair">
-  <div><h3>Record version</h3><p><code>(topology_epoch, owner_node_id, owner_sequence)</code> orders mutations on the physical owner.</p></div>
-  <div><h3>Stream sequence</h3><p>Each <code>(epoch, owner, follower)</code> stream has its own contiguous <code>stream_sequence</code>. A follower receives only the mutations for ranges it replicates, so it needs its own counter to spot gaps.</p></div>
-</div>
-<p>When a follower sees a gap, it catches up from retained history or from a snapshot. It never skips the gap. A new topology epoch starts new streams and new readiness checks.</p>
-<p>Retries cover a different failure. Say the owner applies a write, but the reply never reaches the client:</p>
-
-<figure>
-<div class="scroll">
-<svg viewBox="0 0 820 390" role="img" aria-labelledby="f7-title">
-  <title id="f7-title">The client sends mutation ID m with payload p to the current owner. The owner applies it and keeps the fingerprint and result. The reply is lost. The client retries m with the same p. The owner finds the receipt for m, does not apply the mutation again, and returns the stored result.</title>
-  <rect class="box" x="100" y="14" width="160" height="48" rx="9"/><text class="t" x="180" y="43" text-anchor="middle">Client</text>
-  <rect class="box accent" x="520" y="14" width="200" height="48" rx="9"/><text class="t" x="620" y="43" text-anchor="middle">Current owner</text>
-  <line class="life" x1="180" y1="62" x2="180" y2="382"/>
-  <line class="life" x1="620" y1="62" x2="620" y2="382"/>
-
-  <line class="data" x1="180" y1="100" x2="619" y2="100" marker-end="url(#ah-ink)"/>
-  <text class="lbl" x="400" y="92" text-anchor="middle">Mutation ID m, payload p</text>
-  <rect class="box soft" x="522" y="116" width="196" height="46" rx="7"/>
-  <text class="s ink" x="620" y="135" text-anchor="middle">Apply</text>
-  <text class="s ink" x="620" y="153" text-anchor="middle">Keep fingerprint and result</text>
-
-  <line class="reply bad" x1="620" y1="196" x2="412" y2="196"/>
-  <path class="x-mark" d="M396,186 l16,20 M412,186 l-16,20"/>
-  <text class="lbl bad" x="516" y="188" text-anchor="middle">Reply lost</text>
-

-  <text class="lbl" x="400" y="232" text-anchor="middle">Retry m with the same p</text>
-  <rect class="box soft" x="522" y="256" width="196" height="46" rx="7"/>
-  <text class="s ink" x="620" y="275" text-anchor="middle">Find receipt for m</text>
-  <text class="s ink" x="620" y="293" text-anchor="middle">Do not apply again</text>
-
-  <line class="reply ok" x1="620" y1="340" x2="181" y2="340" marker-end="url(#ah-ok)"/>
-  <text class="lbl ok" x="400" y="332" text-anchor="middle">Stored result, applied once</text>

-
-<p>The client keeps the same mutation ID across refreshes and retries. Deduplication receipts replicate along with mutations, so a promoted successor can answer a retry from what it received. This does not bring back writes that <code>OwnerOnly</code> lost.</p>
-<p>Receipts are kept for 60 seconds. Within that window a mutation runs at most once. There is no exactly-once guarantee beyond it. If the receipt store runs out of budget, the owner rejects new writes before applying them rather than evict receipts early. Reusing an ID with different content is a conflict.</p>
-<p>Each error carries two separate facts: <strong>why the attempt stopped</strong> and <strong>whether the mutation might have been applied</strong>. A deadline can expire with either <code>KnownNotApplied</code> or <code>MayHaveApplied</code>. Once an outcome is uncertain, later retry failures cannot turn it back into a known one. A single end-to-end deadline covers connecting, topology refresh, backoff, and every RPC attempt.</p>
-<p class="source"><a href="0001-ha-for-consistent-hash-cache.md#1-mutation-ordering-and-replication-streams">Replication streams</a> · <a href="0001-ha-for-consistent-hash-cache.md#3-mutation-idempotency">Idempotency</a> · <a href="0001-ha-for-consistent-hash-cache.md#4-error-and-retry-semantics">Retry semantics</a></p>
-</section>
-
-<!-- 8 -->
-<section id="limits" aria-labelledby="h-limits">
-<div class="sec-head"><span class="sec-num">08</span><h2 id="h-limits">Guarantees and limits</h2><span class="time">1 min</span></div>
-<p class="takeaway">The design makes you choose between write availability and the risk of losing acknowledged writes, and states which one you chose.</p>
-<p>Questions you will probably get:</p>
-
-<dl class="faq">
-  <div><dt>Does RF=3 mean every successful write is on three nodes?</dt><dd>Only under <code>AllReplicas</code>. RF says where copies should live. The ACK policy says what success means.</dd></div>
-  <div><dt>Can a follower answer a normal GET?</dt><dd><b>No.</b> Reads go to the current leased owner.</dd></div>
-  <div><dt>Is <code>OwnerOnly</code> linearizable across failover?</dt><dd><b>No.</b> Per-key linearizability holds within one owner epoch. After failover, clients may see older state.</dd></div>
-  <div><dt>Can we recover from an incomplete copy?</dt><dd><b>No.</b> It cannot be promoted without complete admitted coverage, so the range stays unavailable.</dd></div>
-  <div><dt>Does durable coordinator metadata make cached data durable?</dt><dd><b>No.</b> Cached data and its ACKs live in memory.</dd></div>
-  <div><dt>Does cache-node HA cover coordinator failure?</dt><dd><b>No.</b> Nodes stop serving when their leases expire. Coordinator HA is out of scope.</dd></div>
-  <div><dt>How do we explain why a range is blocked?</dt><dd>Check the epoch and owner, the lease, desired versus admitted copies, stream lag and gaps, the active policy, the guards, and the repair phase.</dd></div>
-</dl>
-
-<p>For more depth, see the RFC's <a href="0001-ha-for-consistent-hash-cache.md#test-plan">test plan</a> and <a href="0001-ha-for-consistent-hash-cache.md#verification">verification criteria</a>. They define the evidence the guarantees depend on. This walkthrough is not that evidence.</p>
-</section>

+<p class="takeaway">The first distinct physical successor is a follower now and the replacement owner later.</p>
+<p>A key hashes to a token. Walking clockwise, the first token's node owns the key, and the next distinct physical nodes are its followers. Virtual-node tokens spread ownership across the physical nodes. A second token from a node that is already in the set does not add a replica.</p>

+<p>A key at token 15 is owned by A, and its desired replicas are <strong>A, B, C</strong>. Token 25 also belongs to A, so follower selection skips it.</p>
+<p>Now remove A. Both of its tokens disappear, and B owns the merged interval <code>(10, 40]</code>. The desired replicas become <strong>B, C, D</strong>. B can take over only if its admitted coverage includes the whole merged interval, not just the part it followed before.</p>
+<p>Two design choices follow from this:</p>
+<ul>
+<li>Promotion follows the ring. It does not pick the least-loaded replica or the one that looks most up to date, so routing and recovery use the same rule.</li>
+<li>Ranges are defined by their bounds in the current topology. They have no permanent shard ID. A joining node splits intervals, and a departing node merges them. Readiness has to be proved for whatever bounds result.</li>
+</ul>
+<p>This slice shows one promotion. In a real ring with many vnodes, the ranges of a failed node move to several different successors.</p>
+<p class="source"><a href="0001-ha-for-consistent-hash-cache.md#1-ring-ranges-and-placement">Ring, ranges, and placement</a></p>
+</section>
+
+<!-- 3 -->
+<section id="readiness" aria-labelledby="h-readiness">
+<div class="sec-head"><span class="sec-num">03</span><h2 id="h-readiness">Placement, readiness, and authority are separate</h2><span class="time">2 min</span></div>
+<p class="takeaway">A node listed in the ring may not have the data yet, and may not be allowed to serve.</p>
+
+<div class="table-wrap" role="region" aria-label="Placement, readiness, and authority" tabindex="0"><table>
+<thead><tr><th>Question</th><th>Answered by</th><th>What it establishes</th></tr></thead>
+<tbody>
+<tr><td>Where should this range live?</td><td>Committed topology: epoch, tokens, RF, policy, guards, digest</td><td>The owner and the ordered list of desired followers</td></tr>
+<tr><td>Does this copy have the full history?</td><td>Durable admission record for an exact epoch, range, node, and verified watermark</td><td>The copy has all initial data and a contiguous mutation history</td></tr>
+<tr><td>Can this follower be counted on right now?</td><td>Admission, a live connection, and lag within the configured bound</td><td>The follower is healthy for the write gates</td></tr>
+<tr><td>May this owner serve right now?</td><td>Installed topology, a valid lease for the node and epoch, and fencing</td><td>The owner has authority for this epoch</td></tr>
+<tr><td>May this write succeed right now?</td><td>Availability guards and the ACK policy</td><td>Enough eligible copies exist and the required ACKs arrived</td></tr>
+</tbody></table></div>
+
+<p>For example, D can be a desired follower while its snapshot is still arriving. Until D is admitted, it does not count as a replica. An admitted copy can also drop out later if it disconnects or falls too far behind.</p>
+<p>Admission changes do not bump the topology epoch, and clients never see them. Repair can therefore make progress without disturbing routing. Changes to ownership or policy do require a new committed epoch.</p>
+<p class="source"><a href="0001-ha-for-consistent-hash-cache.md#2-committed-topology-contract">Committed topology</a> · <a href="0001-ha-for-consistent-hash-cache.md#3-desired-placement-versus-operational-readiness">Readiness</a></p>
+</section>
+
+<!-- 4 -->
+<section id="policy" aria-labelledby="h-policy">
+<div class="sec-head"><span class="sec-num">04</span><h2 id="h-policy">The write policy defines success</h2><span class="time">2 min</span></div>
+<p class="takeaway">Waiting for the node that would be promoted is what makes an ACK survive failover.</p>
+<p>An ACK always means the mutation was applied in memory, never that it reached disk. Assuming the owner has authority and the guards pass:</p>
+
+<ul class="policies">
+  <li class="policy">
+    <h3><code>OwnerOnly</code><span class="tag">default</span></h3>
+    <div class="copies" role="img" aria-label="Waits for A only"><span class="copy wait owner">A</span><span class="copy">B</span><span class="copy">C</span></div>
+    <dl><dt>Must apply before success</dt><dd>Owner</dd><dt>Cost and failure behavior</dt><dd>No follower wait. If the owner fails, recent acknowledged writes can be lost.</dd></dl>
+  </li>
+  <li class="policy">
+    <h3><code>FirstSuccessor</code></h3>
+    <div class="copies" role="img" aria-label="Waits for A and B"><span class="copy wait owner">A</span><span class="copy wait">B</span><span class="copy">C</span></div>
+    <dl><dt>Must apply before success</dt><dd>Owner and the first successor</dd><dt>Cost and failure behavior</dt><dd>One replication round trip. From a healthy state, acknowledged writes survive any single failure.</dd></dl>
+  </li>
+  <li class="policy">
+    <h3><code>AllReplicas</code></h3>
+    <div class="copies" role="img" aria-label="Waits for A, B, and C"><span class="copy wait owner">A</span><span class="copy wait">B</span><span class="copy wait">C</span></div>
+    <dl><dt>Must apply before success</dt><dd>Every node in the desired replica set</dd><dt>Cost and failure behavior</dt><dd>Waits for every copy. Writes stop while the range is under-replicated.</dd></dl>
+  </li>
+</ul>
+<p class="policy-note">Filled circles are the copies that must apply a write before the client sees success, for RF=3 with owner A, first successor B, and later follower C.</p>
+
+<p>Here is a successful <code>FirstSuccessor</code> write at RF=3 with both followers admitted. The client gets its response without waiting for the later follower.</p>

B checks authority and order, applies in memory, and sends an applied ACK. A returns success with the record version. C's ACK is not required.</title>

+
+<p>Why not accept any two copies? Suppose A and C acknowledge while B lags. If A then fails, the ring still promotes B, and B is missing the write. A second ACK only helps if it comes from B.</p>
+<p>Guards are a separate check that runs before the write. By default they require one admitted copy and zero healthy followers, so a leased <code>OwnerOnly</code> owner can accept writes on its own. Stricter guards give up some availability to reduce the chance of loss. <code>AllReplicas</code> always means the full desired set, never just the copies that happen to be up.</p>

+</section>

+<div class="sec-head"><span class="sec-num">05</span><h2 id="h-failover">Reads and writes recover at different times</h2><span class="time">2 min</span></div>
+<p class="takeaway">A new owner can serve reads before it is allowed to acknowledge writes.</p>

If the write gate is met, writes resume. Otherwise writes stay blocked.</title>

+<p>Under <code>FirstSuccessor</code>, B may hold every acknowledged write when A fails. Once B owns the range, though, C becomes B's first successor. If C is behind, B has to wait for C to catch up and be admitted before writes can succeed again. Otherwise the next acknowledged write would have no protected copy.</p>
+<p>Under <code>OwnerOnly</code>, writes resume as soon as the guards pass, and some recently acknowledged writes may already be gone. Under <code>AllReplicas</code>, every desired copy must be ready. If too few members remain, writes stay blocked until capacity comes back.</p>
+
+<div class="pair">
+  <div><h3>Fencing</h3><p>Fencing stops two owners from serving the same range. A lease covers <code>(node_id, topology_epoch)</code>, and the process-instance ID means a restarted process with empty memory cannot pick up the old instance's authority. GET needs a valid lease too.</p></div>
+  <div><h3>Confirming a failure</h3><p>A single broken link does not say which end has failed. A missing or expired lease is enough to confirm a failure. Otherwise at least two independent nodes must report the member unreachable. If only one pair of nodes disagrees, the affected ranges stay degraded and nobody is evicted.</p></div>
+</div>
+<p>The default lease is five seconds, but that is a fencing parameter. It is <strong>not a five-second failover target</strong>.</p>
+<p class="source"><a href="0001-ha-for-consistent-hash-cache.md#2-owner-leases-and-fencing">Leases</a> · <a href="0001-ha-for-consistent-hash-cache.md#3-failure-suspicion-and-confirmation">Failure confirmation</a> · <a href="0001-ha-for-consistent-hash-cache.md#4-failover">Failover</a></p>
+</section>

+<!-- 6 -->
+<section id="movement" aria-labelledby="h-movement">
+<div class="sec-head"><span class="sec-num">06</span><h2 id="h-movement">Copies are verified before they are used</h2><span class="time">1 min</span></div>
+<p class="takeaway">Every transition waits for a copy that has been snapshotted, caught up, and verified.</p>
+
+<figure>
+<div class="scroll">
+<svg viewBox="0 0 820 110" role="img" aria-labelledby="f6-title">
+  <title id="f6-title">Snapshot, then catch up, then verify, then admit or stage.</title>
+  <path class="box soft" d="M8,18 H182 L204,55 L182,92 H8 Z"/>
+  <text class="t" x="100" y="52" text-anchor="middle">Snapshot</text>
+  <text class="s" x="100" y="71" text-anchor="middle">copy current data</text>
+  <path class="box soft" d="M210,18 H384 L406,55 L384,92 H210 L232,55 Z"/>
+  <text class="t" x="312" y="52" text-anchor="middle">Catch up</text>
+  <text class="s" x="312" y="71" text-anchor="middle">stream new mutations</text>
+  <path class="box soft" d="M412,18 H586 L608,55 L586,92 H412 L434,55 Z"/>
+  <text class="t" x="514" y="52" text-anchor="middle">Verify</text>
+  <text class="s" x="514" y="71" text-anchor="middle">count, digest, watermark</text>
+  <path class="box ok" d="M614,18 H812 V92 H614 L636,55 Z"/>
+  <text class="t ok" x="722" y="52" text-anchor="middle">Admit or stage</text>
+  <text class="s" x="722" y="71" text-anchor="middle">usable in a transition</text>
+</svg>
+</div>
+</figure>
+
+<div class="table-wrap" role="region" aria-label="Data movement operations" tabindex="0"><table>
+<thead><tr><th>Operation</th><th>What changes</th><th>What must hold before the result is used</th></tr></thead>
+<tbody>
+<tr><td>Scale-out</td><td>New tokens split ranges and add owner and follower duties</td><td>Pause affected writes briefly, drain the last changes, verify, meet the target policy, then commit and activate</td></tr>
+<tr><td>Graceful scale-in</td><td>Removed tokens merge ranges</td><td>Successors cover the merged ranges and downstream followers are ready. Missing data is synced before cutover</td></tr>
+<tr><td>Failure removal</td><td>Ownership moves without help from the failed node</td><td>Old authority is fenced and a surviving admitted copy covers each range. Incomplete copies are not promoted</td></tr>
+<tr><td>Replica repair</td><td>Missing copies are filled in</td><td>Snapshot and incremental history are verified before admission. The topology epoch does not change</td></tr>
+<tr><td>Stronger ACK policy</td><td>More copies become required for success</td><td>Those copies catch up before the stronger policy is committed</td></tr>
+</tbody></table></div>
+
+<p>A graceful scale-in can usually reuse existing replicas instead of copying the owner's whole dataset. Repair still has work to do after a promotion, because the desired follower set shifts. Repair is bounded and resumable. If the topology changes under it, the task's epoch or bounds may no longer match, and it is re-planned.</p>
+<p>A node that was fenced and comes back must rejoin explicitly. It is reset and seeded like a brand-new node. The records it still holds prove nothing.</p>

+<!-- 7 -->
+<section id="retries" aria-labelledby="h-retries">
+<div class="sec-head"><span class="sec-num">07</span><h2 id="h-retries">Ordering and retries solve different problems</h2><span class="time">2 min</span></div>
+<p class="takeaway">A lost reply must not cause a duplicate write, and a missing replication entry must not go unnoticed.</p>
+
+<p>There are two counters, and they do different jobs:</p>
+<div class="pair">
+  <div><h3>Record version</h3><p><code>(topology_epoch, owner_node_id, owner_sequence)</code> orders mutations on the physical owner.</p></div>

+</div>

+<p>Retries cover a different failure. Say the owner applies a write, but the reply never reaches the client:</p>

-```mermaid
-flowchart LR
-    P["Previous<br/>10"] --> A1["A<br/>20"]

-## 3. Placement, readiness, and authority are separate · 2 minutes
-
-**Takeaway: a node listed in the ring may not have the data yet, and may not be allowed to serve.**

-| Question | Answered by | What it establishes |
-| --- | --- | --- |

-| May this owner serve right now? | Installed topology, a valid lease for the node and epoch, and fencing | The owner has authority for this epoch |
-| May this write succeed right now? | Availability guards and the ACK policy | Enough eligible copies exist and the required ACKs arrived |

-## 4. The write policy defines success · 2 minutes
-
-**Takeaway: waiting for the node that would be promoted is what makes an ACK survive failover.**
-
-An ACK always means the mutation was applied in memory, never that it reached disk. Assuming the owner has authority and the guards pass:
-
-| Policy | Must apply before success | Cost and failure behavior |
-| --- | --- | --- |
-| `OwnerOnly` (default) | Owner | No follower wait. If the owner fails, recent acknowledged writes can be lost |
-| `FirstSuccessor` | Owner and the first successor | One replication round trip. From a healthy state, acknowledged writes survive any single failure |
-| `AllReplicas` | Every node in the desired replica set | Waits for every copy. Writes stop while the range is under-replicated |
-
-Here is a successful `FirstSuccessor` write at RF=3 with both followers admitted. The client gets its response without waiting for the later follower.

-```mermaid
-%%{init: {"sequence": {"actorMargin": 20, "width": 120, "diagramMarginX": 10, "mirrorActors": false, "messageMargin": 25}}}%%
-sequenceDiagram
-    participant C as Client
-    participant O as Owner A
-    participant B as First successor<br/>B
-    participant F as Later follower<br/>C
-    C->>O: PUT: epoch + mutation ID
-    O->>O: Check authority + gates<br/>Check mutation ID
-    O->>O: Assign order<br/>Apply in memory
-    O->>B: Mutation + deduplication receipt
-    O->>F: Async mutation + deduplication receipt
-    B->>B: Check authority + order<br/>Apply in memory
-    B-->>O: Applied ACK
-    O-->>C: Success with record version
-    Note over O,F: Later follower ACK is not required
-```

-

-## 5. Reads and writes recover at different times · 2 minutes
-

-```mermaid
-%%{init: {"flowchart": {"rankSpacing": 25, "nodeSpacing": 25}}}%%
-flowchart TD
-    A["Confirm failure and fence old authority"] --> B["Commit removal and derive new ranges"]
-    B --> C("Full admitted coverage?")
-    C -->|No| U[Range unavailable]
-    C -->|Yes| D["Install topology and activate lease"]
-    D --> E[Reads resume]
-    D --> F[Repair missing followers]

-    G -->|Yes| I[Writes resume]

+    A1 --> A2["A<br/>25"]
+    A2 --> B["B<br/>40"]
+    B --> C["C<br/>60"]
+    C --> D["D<br/>80"]
+```
+
+A key at token 15 is owned by A, and its desired replicas are **A, B, C**. Token 25 also belongs to A, so follower selection skips it.
+
+Now remove A. Both of its tokens disappear, and B owns the merged interval `(10, 40]`. The desired replicas become **B, C, D**. B can take over only if its admitted coverage includes the whole merged interval, not just the part it followed before.
+
+Two design choices follow from this:
+
+- Promotion follows the ring. It does not pick the least-loaded replica or the one that looks most up to date, so routing and recovery use the same rule.
+- Ranges are defined by their bounds in the current topology. They have no permanent shard ID. A joining node splits intervals, and a departing node merges them. Readiness has to be proved for whatever bounds result.
+
+This slice shows one promotion. In a real ring with many vnodes, the ranges of a failed node move to several different successors.
+
+Source: [Ring, ranges, and placement](0001-ha-for-consistent-hash-cache.md#1-ring-ranges-and-placement).
+
+## 3. Placement, readiness, and authority are separate · 2 minutes
+
+**Takeaway: a node listed in the ring may not have the data yet, and may not be allowed to serve.**
+
+| Question | Answered by | What it establishes |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| Where should this range live? | Committed topology: epoch, tokens, RF, policy, guards, digest | The owner and the ordered list of desired followers |
+| Does this copy have the full history? | Durable admission record for an exact epoch, range, node, and verified watermark | The copy has all initial data and a contiguous mutation history |
+| Can this follower be counted on right now? | Admission, a live connection, and lag within the configured bound | The follower is healthy for the write gates |
+| May this owner serve right now? | Installed topology, a valid lease for the node and epoch, and fencing | The owner has authority for this epoch |
+| May this write succeed right now? | Availability guards and the ACK policy | Enough eligible copies exist and the required ACKs arrived |
+
+For example, D can be a desired follower while its snapshot is still arriving. Until D is admitted, it does not count as a replica. An admitted copy can also drop out later if it disconnects or falls too far behind.
+
+Admission changes do not bump the topology epoch, and clients never see them. Repair can therefore make progress without disturbing routing. Changes to ownership or policy do require a new committed epoch.
+
+Source: [Committed topology](0001-ha-for-consistent-hash-cache.md#2-committed-topology-contract), [Readiness](0001-ha-for-consistent-hash-cache.md#3-desired-placement-versus-operational-readiness).
+
+## 4. The write policy defines success · 2 minutes
+
+**Takeaway: waiting for the node that would be promoted is what makes an ACK survive failover.**
+
+An ACK always means the mutation was applied in memory, never that it reached disk. Assuming the owner has authority and the guards pass:
+
+| Policy | Must apply before success | Cost and failure behavior |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| `OwnerOnly` (default) | Owner | No follower wait. If the owner fails, recent acknowledged writes can be lost |
+| `FirstSuccessor` | Owner and the first successor | One replication round trip. From a healthy state, acknowledged writes survive any single failure |
+| `AllReplicas` | Every node in the desired replica set | Waits for every copy. Writes stop while the range is under-replicated |
+
+Here is a successful `FirstSuccessor` write at RF=3 with both followers admitted. The client gets its response without waiting for the later follower.
+
+```mermaid
+%%{init: {"sequence": {"actorMargin": 20, "width": 120, "diagramMarginX": 10, "mirrorActors": false, "messageMargin": 25}}}%%
+sequenceDiagram
+    participant C as Client
+    participant O as Owner A
+    participant B as First successor<br/>B
+    participant F as Later follower<br/>C
+    C->>O: PUT: epoch + mutation ID
+    O->>O: Check authority + gates<br/>Check mutation ID
+    O->>O: Assign order<br/>Apply in memory
+    O->>B: Mutation + deduplication receipt
+    O->>F: Async mutation + deduplication receipt
+    B->>B: Check authority + order<br/>Apply in memory
+    B-->>O: Applied ACK
+    O-->>C: Success with record version
+    Note over O,F: Later follower ACK is not required
+```
+
+Why not accept any two copies? Suppose A and C acknowledge while B lags. If A then fails, the ring still promotes B, and B is missing the write. A second ACK only helps if it comes from B.
+
+Guards are a separate check that runs before the write. By default they require one admitted copy and zero healthy followers, so a leased `OwnerOnly` owner can accept writes on its own. Stricter guards give up some availability to reduce the chance of loss. `AllReplicas` always means the full desired set, never just the copies that happen to be up.
+
+Source: [Consistency contract](0001-ha-for-consistent-hash-cache.md#5-consistency-contract), [Owner write path](0001-ha-for-consistent-hash-cache.md#2-owner-write-path).
+
+## 5. Reads and writes recover at different times · 2 minutes
+
+**Takeaway: a new owner can serve reads before it is allowed to acknowledge writes.**
+
+```mermaid
+%%{init: {"flowchart": {"rankSpacing": 25, "nodeSpacing": 25}}}%%
+flowchart TD
+    A["Confirm failure and fence old authority"] --> B["Commit removal and derive new ranges"]
+    B --> C("Full admitted coverage?")
+    C -->|No| U[Range unavailable]
+    C -->|Yes| D["Install topology and activate lease"]
+    D --> E[Reads resume]
+    D --> F[Repair missing followers]
+    E --> G("Write gate met?")
+    F -.->|Readiness updates| G
+    G -->|No| H[Writes blocked]
+    G -->|Yes| I[Writes resume]
+```
+
+Under `FirstSuccessor`, B may hold every acknowledged write when A fails. Once B owns the range, though, C becomes B's first successor. If C is behind, B has to wait for C to catch up and be admitted before writes can succeed again. Otherwise the next acknowledged write would have no protected copy.
+
+Under `OwnerOnly`, writes resume as soon as the guards pass, and some recently acknowledged writes may already be gone. Under `AllReplicas`, every desired copy must be ready. If too few members remain, writes stay blocked until capacity comes back.
+
+Fencing stops two owners from serving the same range. A lease covers `(node_id, topology_epoch)`, and the process-instance ID means a restarted process with empty memory cannot pick up the old instance's authority. GET needs a valid lease too.
+
+A single broken link does not say which end has failed. A missing or expired lease is enough to confirm a failure. Otherwise at least two independent nodes must report the member unreachable. If only one pair of nodes disagrees, the affected ranges stay degraded and nobody is evicted. The default lease is five seconds, but that is a fencing parameter. It is **not a five-second failover target**.
+
+Source: [Leases](0001-ha-for-consistent-hash-cache.md#2-owner-leases-and-fencing), [Failure confirmation](0001-ha-for-consistent-hash-cache.md#3-failure-suspicion-and-confirmation), [Failover](0001-ha-for-consistent-hash-cache.md#4-failover).
+
+## 6. Copies are verified before they are used · 1 minute
+
+**Takeaway: every transition waits for a copy that has been snapshotted, caught up, and verified.**
+
+```mermaid
+flowchart LR
+    S[Snapshot] --> L[Catch up]
+    L --> V[Verify]
+    V --> R[Admit or stage]
+```
+
+| Operation | What changes | What must hold before the result is used |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| Scale-out | New tokens split ranges and add owner and follower duties | Pause affected writes briefly, drain the last changes, verify, meet the target policy, then commit and activate |
+| Graceful scale-in | Removed tokens merge ranges | Successors cover the merged ranges and downstream followers are ready. Missing data is synced before cutover |
+| Failure removal | Ownership moves without help from the failed node | Old authority is fenced and a surviving admitted copy covers each range. Incomplete copies are not promoted |
+| Replica repair | Missing copies are filled in | Snapshot and incremental history are verified before admission. The topology epoch does not change |
+| Stronger ACK policy | More copies become required for success | Those copies catch up before the stronger policy is committed |
+
+A graceful scale-in can usually reuse existing replicas instead of copying the owner's whole dataset. Repair still has work to do after a promotion, because the desired follower set shifts. Repair is bounded and resumable. If the topology changes under it, the task's epoch or bounds may no longer match, and it is re-planned.
+
+A node that was fenced and comes back must rejoin explicitly. It is reset and seeded like a brand-new node. The records it still holds prove nothing.
+
+Source: [Membership and data movement](0001-ha-for-consistent-hash-cache.md#membership-and-data-movement).
+
+## 7. Ordering and retries solve different problems · 2 minutes
+
+**Takeaway: a lost reply must not cause a duplicate write, and a missing replication entry must not go unnoticed.**
+
+There are two counters, and they do different jobs:
+
+- The record version `(topology_epoch, owner_node_id, owner_sequence)` orders mutations on the physical owner.
+- Each `(epoch, owner, follower)` stream has its own contiguous `stream_sequence`. A follower receives only the mutations for ranges it replicates, so it needs its own counter to spot gaps.
+
+When a follower sees a gap, it catches up from retained history or from a snapshot. It never skips the gap. A new topology epoch starts new streams and new readiness checks.
+
+Retries cover a different failure. Say the owner applies a write, but the reply never reaches the client:
+
+```mermaid
+sequenceDiagram
+    participant C as Client
+    participant O as Current authoritative owner
+    C->>O: Mutation ID m, payload p
+    O->>O: Apply and retain fingerprint/result
+    O--xC: Reply lost
+    C->>O: Retry m with the same p
+    O->>O: Consult retained deduplication state
+    O-->>C: Answer retry without applying twice
+```
+
+The client keeps the same mutation ID across refreshes and retries. Deduplication receipts replicate along with mutations, so a promoted successor can answer a retry from what it received. This does not bring back writes that `OwnerOnly` lost.
+
+Receipts are kept for 60 seconds. Within that window a mutation runs at most once. There is no exactly-once guarantee beyond it. If the receipt store runs out of budget, the owner rejects new writes before applying them rather than evict receipts early. Reusing an ID with different content is a conflict.
+
+Each error carries two separate facts: **why the attempt stopped** and **whether the mutation might have been applied**. A deadline can expire with either `KnownNotApplied` or `MayHaveApplied`. Once an outcome is uncertain, later retry failures cannot turn it back into a known one. A single end-to-end deadline covers connecting, topology refresh, backoff, and every RPC attempt.
+
+Source: [Replication streams](0001-ha-for-consistent-hash-cache.md#1-mutation-ordering-and-replication-streams), [Idempotency](0001-ha-for-consistent-hash-cache.md#3-mutation-idempotency), [Retry semantics](0001-ha-for-consistent-hash-cache.md#4-error-and-retry-semantics).
+
+## 8. Guarantees and limits · 1 minute
+
+**Takeaway: the design makes you choose between write availability and the risk of losing acknowledged writes, and states which one you chose.**
+
+| Question you will probably get | Answer |
+| --- | --- |
+| Does RF=3 mean every successful write is on three nodes? | Only under `AllReplicas`. RF says where copies should live. The ACK policy says what success means. |
+| Can a follower answer a normal GET? | No. Reads go to the current leased owner. |
+| Is `OwnerOnly` linearizable across failover? | No. Per-key linearizability holds within one owner epoch. After failover, clients may see older state. |
+| Can we recover from an incomplete copy? | No. It cannot be promoted without complete admitted coverage, so the range stays unavailable. |
+| Does durable coordinator metadata make cached data durable? | No. Cached data and its ACKs live in memory. |
+| Does cache-node HA cover coordinator failure? | No. Nodes stop serving when their leases expire. Coordinator HA is out of scope. |
+| How do we explain why a range is blocked? | Check the epoch and owner, the lease, desired versus admitted copies, stream lag and gaps, the active policy, the guards, and the repair phase. |
+
+For more depth, see the RFC's [test plan](0001-ha-for-consistent-hash-cache.md#test-plan) and [verification criteria](0001-ha-for-consistent-hash-cache.md#verification). They define the evidence the guarantees depend on. This walkthrough is not that evidence.

+<body>
+<main>
+<p class="eyebrow">HASHRING-RS · 总体方案设计补充材料</p>
+<h1>缩容与故障接管：<br>副本放置即接管计划</h1>
+<p class="lede">一个区间的第一个 follower，恰好是 owner 离开后环会自然选出的新 owner。所以节点离开时，它的区间直接并入下一个 owner 的管辖范围，而这个 owner 早已作为 follower 持有这部分数据。</p>
+<div class="thesis">
+  <div><b>不需要选举</b><span>接管者由环的结构决定，所有参与方用同一份拓扑算出同一个答案。</span></div>
+  <div><b>关键路径上不搬数据</b><span>新 owner 用它作为 follower 时早已持有的记录直接服务。</span></div>
+  <div><b>先恢复服务，再恢复冗余</b><span>缺少的副本在后台以快照加增量补齐。</span></div>
+</div>
+
+<h2><span class="num">01</span>在环上看接管过程</h2>
+<p class="sub">环上共 5 个节点，每个节点 3 个 token。点击环上任意一段区间，可以看到副本列表是怎样“从区间末端顺时针走、跳过重复的物理节点”推导出来的。然后选择一个节点，逐步查看计划内缩容或故障接管。</p>
+
+<div class="card">
+<div class="stage">
+  <div class="ringbox"><svg id="ring" viewBox="0 0 460 460" role="img" aria-label="一致性哈希环"></svg>
+    <div class="legend">
+      <span><i class="n has" style="background:var(--nB)">B</i>已持有数据并已准入</span>
+      <span><i class="n miss">D</i>需补数据</span>
+      <span><i class="n reverify" style="background:var(--nC)">C</i>故障路径：后台重新复制并准入</span>
+    </div>
+  </div>
+  <div class="ctl">
+    <div class="row"><span class="lbl">场景</span>
+      <div class="seg" id="mode">
+        <button data-v="graceful" aria-pressed="true">计划内缩容</button>
+        <button data-v="failure" aria-pressed="false">节点故障</button>
+      </div></div>
+    <div class="row"><span class="lbl">离开节点</span><div class="row" id="nodes"></div></div>
+    <div class="row"><span class="lbl">复制因子</span>
+      <div class="seg" id="rf">
+        <button data-v="2" aria-pressed="false">RF = 2</button>
+        <button data-v="3" aria-pressed="true">RF = 3</button>
+      </div></div>
+    <div class="steps" id="dots"></div>
+    <div class="stepcard" aria-live="polite"><h3 id="stitle"></h3><p id="sbody"></p></div>
+    <div class="row">
+      <button class="btn" id="prev">上一步</button>
+      <button class="btn primary" id="next">下一步</button>
+      <button class="btn" id="reset">重置</button>
+    </div>
+    <div class="metrics">
+      <div class="metric"><b id="m1"></b><span>离开节点作为 owner 负责的键空间</span></div>
+      <div class="metric"><b>0%</b><span>接管时关键路径上需要复制的键空间</span></div>
+      <div class="metric"><b id="m3"></b><span id="m3l">后台补齐的副本量</span></div>
+    </div>
+  </div>
+</div>
+<h3 style="margin:26px 0 6px;font-size:1rem">受影响的区间：副本列表如何变化</h3>
+<p class="note" style="margin:0 0 8px" id="tnote"></p>
+<table><thead><tr><th>原区间</th><th>原副本列表</th><th>移除后并入的区间</th><th>新副本列表</th></tr></thead><tbody id="rows"></tbody></table>
+</div>
+
+<h2><span class="num">02</span>为什么要等“第一个 follower”确认</h2>
+<p class="sub">接管者是确定的，所以写入策略只要让它在确认前先收到写入，已确认的写入就能在 owner 故障后保留下来。选择一个策略并播放：owner A 确认一次写入 <code>k = v2</code> 后立即宕机，异步复制还没送达的副本仍是旧值 <code>v1</code>。</p>
+<div class="card">
+  <div class="row" style="margin-bottom:14px"><span class="lbl">写入策略</span>
+    <div class="seg" id="policy">
+      <button data-v="owner" aria-pressed="true">OwnerOnly</button>
+      <button data-v="any2" aria-pressed="false">任意两个副本（反例）</button>
+      <button data-v="first" aria-pressed="false">FirstSuccessor</button>
+      <button data-v="all" aria-pressed="false">AllReplicas</button>
+    </div>
+    <button class="btn primary" id="play">播放</button>
+  </div>
+  <div class="grid5" id="lanes"></div>
+  <div class="verdict" id="verdict"></div>
+</div>
+
+<h2><span class="num">03</span>实测：缩容比扩容快一个数量级</h2>
+<p class="sub">仓库记录的 20 次连续测试：9 ↔ 10 个节点，RF=3，<code>FirstSuccessor</code>，20,000 个键，迁移期间持续写入。扩容需要为新节点复制数据；缩容时数据已在继承者手中，只需短暂停写、追平复制流并发布新拓扑。</p>
+<div class="card" id="bars">
+  <div class="bar"><span>扩容（中位数）</span><div class="track"><div class="fill" style="width:0;background:var(--nB)" data-w="100"></div></div><b>7.958 s</b></div>
+  <div class="bar"><span>缩容（中位数）</span><div class="track"><div class="fill" style="width:0;background:var(--accent)" data-w="7.48"></div></div><b>0.595 s</b></div>
+  <p class="note">缩容最小 0.568 s、最大 0.616 s；扩容最小 7.781 s、最大 8.463 s。这是单机本地的小规模测量，只说明两条路径的量级差别，不代表百万键规模的迁移性能。来源：<a href="../optimizations/replica-ack-performance.md"><code>replica-ack-performance.md</code></a>。</p>
+</div>
+
+<footer>
+  文字说明见 <a href="0001-scale-in-failover.md">0001-scale-in-failover.md</a>，设计契约见 <a href="0001-ha-for-consistent-hash-cache.md">RFC 0001</a>。相关代码：副本推导 <a href="../../crates/hashring-core/src/topology.rs"><code>topology.rs</code></a>；自然继承的缩容 <a href="../../crates/hashring-coordinator/src/merge.rs"><code>merge.rs</code></a>；覆盖证明 <a href="../../crates/hashring-coordinator/src/removal.rs"><code>removal.rs</code></a>；故障接管 <a href="../../crates/hashring-coordinator/src/failure.rs"><code>failure.rs</code></a>、<a href="../../crates/hashring-coordinator/src/change.rs"><code>change.rs</code></a>。演示中的环是示意数据，真实系统每个节点默认有 128 个 token。
+</footer>
+</main>
+
+<script>
+(() => {
+const NODES = ['A','B','C','D','E'];
+const color = n => `var(--n${n})`;
+const TOKENS = [[8,'A'],[30,'C'],[52,'B'],[71,'E'],[95,'D'],[118,'A'],[140,'B'],[163,'C'],
+  [190,'E'],[214,'A'],[236,'D'],[258,'B'],[283,'C'],[307,'E'],[332,'D']];
+
+const S = {mode:'graceful', x:'A', rf:3, step:0, sel:null, lastPublished:false};
+
+const STEPS = {
+  graceful: [
+    ['初始状态', '每段区间的副本列表都由环推导：从区间末端出发顺时针走，依次收集不同的物理节点。注意 {X} 的每段区间，第一个 follower 都是谁。'],
+    ['暂停受影响的写入，等待复制流追平', '{X} 仍在线，读请求照常进行。Coordinator 暂停相关写入，等待 {X} 发往各继承者的复制流全部被应用。已追平的 follower 的准入记录将直接带入新拓扑。'],
+    ['发布新 epoch：区间并入继承者', '{X} 的 token 从环上删除，相邻区间合并。每段合并区间的新 owner 正是原来的第一个 follower，它早已持有数据，安装新拓扑后立刻用原有记录服务，没有复制任何数据。'],
+    ['后台补齐副本', '副本列表去掉 {X} 后，其余节点依次前移一位，末尾补上顺时针的下一个节点。只有这个新补上的节点缺少部分数据，它在后台以快照加增量获得数据，验证后准入。'],
+    ['完成：停止离开的节点', '不再需要的旧副本被清理，最后才停止 {X}。整个过程中，读取从未中断，写入只在追平尾部的短暂窗口内暂停。'],
+  ],
+  failure: [
+    ['初始状态', '每段区间的副本列表都由环推导。注意 {X} 的每段区间，第一个 follower 都是谁：它就是 {X} 故障后的接管者。'],
+    ['{X} 突然失联', '{X} 负责的区间暂时无法读写，客户端在截止时间内重试。与缩容不同，{X} 最后尚未复制出去的写入已经无法追平。'],
+    ['确认故障，等待旧租约过期', '租约过期即可确认故障，否则需要至少两个独立节点报告不可达。Coordinator 停止续约并等到 {X} 的租约一定已过期：即使 {X} 其实还活着，它也会自行停止服务，不会出现两个 owner。'],
+    ['证明覆盖，发布新 epoch：读恢复', '检查每段合并区间的新 owner 对每个组成部分都持有准入记录，然后发布新拓扑。继承者用已有数据立刻恢复读取。旧准入绑定旧 epoch，所以 follower 都显示为“待重新准入”。'],
+    ['后台修复，写入按策略恢复', 'follower 以快照加增量重新复制并准入。OwnerOnly 在满足最低副本要求后即恢复写入；FirstSuccessor 要等新的第一个 follower 准入；AllReplicas 要等全部副本就绪。'],
+    ['完成', '所有区间恢复到期望的副本数。若第一个 follower 缺少准入记录，该区间会保持不可用，而不是用不完整的数据提供服务。'],
+  ],
+};
+const PUBLISH = {graceful:2, failure:3};
+const REPAIRED = {graceful:3, failure:4};
+
+// ---------- ring math ----------
+function buildRanges(tokens, rf){
+  const t = [...tokens].sort((a,b)=>a[0]-b[0]); const n = t.length;
+  return t.map((tok,i)=>{
+    const start = t[(i-1+n)%n][0], end = tok[0];
+    const seen = [], walk = [];
+    for(let o=0;o<n && seen.length<Math.min(rf,new Set(t.map(z=>z[1])).size);o++){
+      const z = t[(i+o)%n]; const fresh = !seen.includes(z[1]);
+      if(fresh) seen.push(z[1]); walk.push({pos:z[0], node:z[1], counted:fresh});
+    }
+    return {start, end, len:((end-start+360)%360)||360, list:seen, walk};
+  });
+}
+const contains = (r,p) => { const d=(p-r.start+360)%360; return d>0 && d<=r.len; };
+const rangeAt = (rs,p) => rs.find(r=>contains(r,p));
+
+// ---------- svg helpers ----------
+const C=230, R=150, W=22;
+const pt = (r,deg) => { const a=deg*Math.PI/180; return [C+r*Math.sin(a), C-r*Math.cos(a)]; };
+function band(a0,len,r1,r2){
+  const a1=a0+len, lg=len>180?1:0;
+  const [x1,y1]=pt(r2,a0),[x2,y2]=pt(r2,a1),[x3,y3]=pt(r1,a1),[x4,y4]=pt(r1,a0);
+  return `M${x1} ${y1}A${r2} ${r2} 0 ${lg} 1 ${x2} ${y2}L${x3} ${y3}A${r1} ${r1} 0 ${lg} 0 ${x4} ${y4}Z`;
+}
+function arcPath(a0,len,r){
+  const lg=len>180?1:0,[x1,y1]=pt(r,a0),[x2,y2]=pt(r,a0+len);
+  return `M${x1} ${y1}A${r} ${r} 0 ${lg} 1 ${x2} ${y2}`;
+}
+const esc = s => s.replace(/\{X\}/g, S.x);
+
+// ---------- render ----------
+const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
+function render(){

+  const before = buildRanges(TOKENS, S.rf);

-# 缩容与故障接管：副本放置即接管计划
-
-本文详细说明 hashring-rs 在节点计划内退出（缩容）和节点故障时如何交接数据的所有权。它是“总体方案设计”一章的补充材料，配套的交互演示见 [0001-scale-in-failover.html](0001-scale-in-failover.html)，设计契约见 [RFC 0001](0001-ha-for-consistent-hash-cache.md)。
-
-**一句话概括：** 一个区间的第一个 follower，恰好是 owner 离开后环会自然选出的新 owner。所以节点离开时，它的区间直接并入下一个 owner 的管辖范围，而这个 owner 早已作为 follower 持有这部分数据。接管不需要选举，关键路径上也不需要搬运大量数据。
-
-## 1. 背景：副本如何放置
-
-### 1.1 环、token 与区间
-
-系统使用一致性哈希环。每个物理节点在环上占据多个 token（虚拟节点）。一个 token 负责它与前一个 token 之间的左开右闭区间 `(前一个 token, 本 token]`。键哈希到环上某点后，沿顺时针方向遇到的第一个 token 所属的节点就是它的 owner。
-
-区间没有永久编号，完全由当前拓扑中相邻 token 的位置决定：新节点加入会插入 token，把区间切开；节点离开会删除 token，让相邻区间合并。
-
-### 1.2 副本列表的推导规则
-
-复制因子为 RF 时，一个区间的副本列表按下面的规则确定：
-
-1. 从区间末端的 token 出发，它所属的节点是 **owner**；
-2. 继续顺时针前进，遇到的 token 如果属于一个**尚未出现在列表中**的物理节点，就把该节点加入列表；
-3. 属于已在列表中的节点的 token 直接跳过（同一台机器存两份没有容错意义）；
-4. 直到列表有 RF 个节点，或所有节点都已加入。
-
-列表中 owner 之后的节点依次称为第一个 follower（first successor）、第二个 follower……
-
-副本位置完全由环推导出来，系统中**没有**任何单独维护的“区间 → 副本”映射表，也不允许人工指定。每个客户端、节点和 Coordinator 拿到同一份拓扑后，算出的副本列表一定相同。
-
-### 1.3 一个例子
-
-设环上一小段 token 依次为（数字表示 token 位置）：
-
-```
-… P(10) → A(20) → A(25) → B(40) → C(60) → D(80) → …
-```
-
-RF=3 时：
-
-| 区间 | owner | 第一个 follower | 第二个 follower | 说明 |
-| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
-| `(10, 20]` | A | B | C | A(25) 属于 A，跳过 |
-| `(20, 25]` | A | B | C | |
-| `(25, 40]` | B | C | D | |
-| `(40, 60]` | C | D | … | |
-
-## 2. 核心观察：第一个 follower 就是下一任 owner
-
-现在把 A 从环上移除。A 的两个 token 20 和 25 消失，`(10, 20]`、`(20, 25]`、`(25, 40]` 三个区间合并为 `(10, 40]`。按同样的规则重新推导：
-
-| 区间 | owner | 第一个 follower | 第二个 follower |
-| --- | --- | --- | --- |
-| `(10, 40]` | B | C | D |
-
-新 owner 是 B，而 B 原本正是 A 那两个区间的第一个 follower。这不是例子里的巧合，而是规则的必然结果：
-
-- 移除 A 之前，A 的区间的第一个 follower，就是“从区间末端顺时针走，跳过所有 A 的 token 后，遇到的第一个节点”；
-- 移除 A 之后，这个区间里的键的 owner，就是“从键的位置顺时针走，遇到的第一个 token 的节点”。A 的 token 已经不存在了，所以这正是同一个节点。
-
-两句话描述的是同一次“跳过 A 往前走”，结果必然相同。代码中的单元测试 `first_successor_becomes_owner_when_the_owner_is_removed` 对每个区间都验证了这一点。
-
-更一般地，**移除一个节点，对任何副本列表的影响都是：把该节点从列表中删掉，后面的节点依次前移一位，再在末尾补上顺时针的下一个节点。** 以上面的例子来看：
-
-| 受影响的区间 | 移除 A 前 | 移除 A 后 | 需要补数据的节点 |
-| --- | --- | --- | --- |
-| A 的区间（并入 `(10, 40]`） | **A**, B, C | B, C, D | D（只缺原属 A 的部分） |
-| B 的区间（并入 `(10, 40]`） | B, C, D | B, C, D | 无 |
-| P 的区间 `(…, 10]` | P, **A**, B | P, B, C | C（新补到末尾的节点） |
-
-前移的节点原本就持有这部分数据，只是换了一个位置；真正缺数据的，只有补到列表末尾的那一个节点。（计划内缩容时，前移节点经验证的准入可以直接带入新拓扑；故障时则需在后台重新验证，见第 6 节。）
-
-## 3. 为什么“并入”不需要搬数据
-
-每个数据节点只有一张内存记录表（`records`），自己作为 owner 负责的键和作为 follower 复制来的键存在同一张表里，并不按角色分开存放。节点是 owner 还是 follower，完全由它当前安装的拓扑决定。
-
-因此，B 从“A 的区间的第一个 follower”变成“合并区间的 owner”，不需要复制、导入或转换任何数据。新拓扑一装上，B 就开始用它早已持有的记录为这些键服务。这就是“follower 的数据并入下一个 owner 的管辖范围”的含义：变化的只是拓扑中的归属关系，数据原地不动。
-
-对比扩容：新节点加入时，它在所有相关区间中都不持有数据，必须经过快照复制、增量回放、短暂停写和校验。缩容和故障接管则把这一步省掉了，或者推迟到后台去做。
-
-## 4. 前提：必须证明新 owner 的数据是完整的
-
-“第一个 follower 持有数据”只是结构上的预期，实际不一定成立。例如：
-
-- follower 刚加入集群，初始快照还没复制完；
-- follower 与 owner 之间的连接断过，复制流有缺口；
-- 区间合并后，新 owner 只覆盖了其中一部分子区间。
-
-所以系统把“应该在哪里”和“确实准备好了”分开记录。Coordinator 为每个 follower 持久化一条**准入（admission）记录**，绑定拓扑 epoch、精确的区间边界、节点和进程实例，只有在快照和连续的增量历史都经过验证后才写入。
-
-接管时，Coordinator 会检查合并后区间的**每一个组成部分**：新 owner 要么原本就是这部分的 owner，要么是这部分的第一个 follower，**并且**持有这部分的准入记录。任何一部分不满足，都不会发布新拓扑，**不完整的副本永远不会被提升**。
-
-## 5. 计划内缩容
-
-当目标拓扑只是删除节点、不同时修改其他配置时，Coordinator 走这条“自然继承”（代码中称为 direct merge）路径：
-
-1. **检查结构条件。** 确认每个合并区间的新 owner 都是各组成部分的原 owner 或第一个 follower，且当前写入策略要求的 follower 在结构上都已持有数据。
-2. **补齐缺失的准入（如有）。** 若某个必需的 follower 还没有准入记录，先在后台完成补种。这一步在停写之前进行，不影响服务。
-3. **短暂暂停写入。** 读请求照常进行。
-4. **等待复制流追平。** 对每一对“旧 owner → 新 owner”以及策略要求的 follower，等待 follower 已应用的序号追上 owner 已发出的序号。离开的节点仍在线，所以它最后的写入可以全部发出去。
-5. **再次验证。** 确认覆盖关系和租约在停写期间没有变化。
-6. **发布新 epoch。** 已追平的 follower 的准入记录直接带入新拓扑。
-7. **激活、清理与停止。** 各节点安装新拓扑后恢复写入；不再需要的副本被删除，最后才停止离开的节点。
-8. **后台补齐副本数。** 列表末尾新补上的节点通过快照加增量获得数据。
-
-在仓库记录的 20 次连续测试中（9 ↔ 10 个节点，RF=3，`FirstSuccessor`，20,000 个键，迁移期间持续写入），需要复制数据的扩容耗时中位数为 7.958 秒，而缩容为 0.595 秒（最小 0.568 秒，最大 0.616 秒）。这是本地、小规模的测量，只说明两种路径的量级差别，不代表百万键规模下的迁移性能。
-
-## 6. 故障接管
-
-故障时离开的节点已经无法配合，流程有三点不同：
-
-1. **确认故障。** 节点的租约已过期即可确认；否则需要至少两个独立节点持续报告它不可达。只有一对节点之间互相连不通时，系统不会贸然驱逐任何一方。
-2. **隔离旧 owner。** Coordinator 停止为它续约，并**等到它的租约一定已经过期**。租约过期的节点会自行停止服务，所以此后不可能有两个 owner 同时接受写入。
-3. **证明覆盖。** 与缩容相同，新 owner 必须对每个组成部分持有准入记录。
-4. **发布新 epoch。** 无法再“追平”故障节点，所以没有停写和等待追平这两步。
-5. **读先恢复，写按策略恢复。** 新拓扑安装、租约生效后读即恢复；写何时恢复取决于写入策略（见下表）。

-## 8. 局限
-
-- **RF=1 时没有 follower**，节点故障后该节点的区间无数据可接管。
-- **连续故障**：如果第一个 follower 在后台修复完成前也发生故障，新 owner 可能没有准入记录，这些区间会变为不可用，而不是返回不完整的数据。

+# 缩容与故障接管：副本放置即接管计划
+
+本文详细说明 hashring-rs 在节点计划内退出（缩容）和节点故障时如何交接数据的所有权。它是“总体方案设计”一章的补充材料，配套的交互演示见 [0001-scale-in-failover.html](0001-scale-in-failover.html)，设计契约见 [RFC 0001](0001-ha-for-consistent-hash-cache.md)。
+
+**一句话概括：** 一个区间的第一个 follower，恰好是 owner 离开后环会自然选出的新 owner。所以节点离开时，它的区间直接并入下一个 owner 的管辖范围，而这个 owner 早已作为 follower 持有这部分数据。接管不需要选举，关键路径上也不需要搬运大量数据。
+
+## 1. 背景：副本如何放置
+
+### 1.1 环、token 与区间
+
+系统使用一致性哈希环。每个物理节点在环上占据多个 token（虚拟节点）。一个 token 负责它与前一个 token 之间的左开右闭区间 `(前一个 token, 本 token]`。键哈希到环上某点后，沿顺时针方向遇到的第一个 token 所属的节点就是它的 owner。
+
+区间没有永久编号，完全由当前拓扑中相邻 token 的位置决定：新节点加入会插入 token，把区间切开；节点离开会删除 token，让相邻区间合并。
+
+### 1.2 副本列表的推导规则
+
+复制因子为 RF 时，一个区间的副本列表按下面的规则确定：
+
+1. 从区间末端的 token 出发，它所属的节点是 **owner**；
+2. 继续顺时针前进，遇到的 token 如果属于一个**尚未出现在列表中**的物理节点，就把该节点加入列表；
+3. 属于已在列表中的节点的 token 直接跳过（同一台机器存两份没有容错意义）；
+4. 直到列表有 RF 个节点，或所有节点都已加入。
+
+列表中 owner 之后的节点依次称为第一个 follower（first successor）、第二个 follower……
+
+副本位置完全由环推导出来，系统中**没有**任何单独维护的“区间 → 副本”映射表，也不允许人工指定。每个客户端、节点和 Coordinator 拿到同一份拓扑后，算出的副本列表一定相同。
+
+### 1.3 一个例子
+
+设环上一小段 token 依次为（数字表示 token 位置）：
+
+```
+… P(10) → A(20) → A(25) → B(40) → C(60) → D(80) → …
+```
+
+RF=3 时：
+
+| 区间 | owner | 第一个 follower | 第二个 follower | 说明 |
+| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
+| `(10, 20]` | A | B | C | A(25) 属于 A，跳过 |
+| `(20, 25]` | A | B | C | |
+| `(25, 40]` | B | C | D | |
+| `(40, 60]` | C | D | … | |
+
+## 2. 核心观察：第一个 follower 就是下一任 owner
+
+现在把 A 从环上移除。A 的两个 token 20 和 25 消失，`(10, 20]`、`(20, 25]`、`(25, 40]` 三个区间合并为 `(10, 40]`。按同样的规则重新推导：
+
+| 区间 | owner | 第一个 follower | 第二个 follower |
+| --- | --- | --- | --- |
+| `(10, 40]` | B | C | D |
+
+新 owner 是 B，而 B 原本正是 A 那两个区间的第一个 follower。这不是例子里的巧合，而是规则的必然结果：
+
+- 移除 A 之前，A 的区间的第一个 follower，就是“从区间末端顺时针走，跳过所有 A 的 token 后，遇到的第一个节点”；
+- 移除 A 之后，这个区间里的键的 owner，就是“从键的位置顺时针走，遇到的第一个 token 的节点”。A 的 token 已经不存在了，所以这正是同一个节点。
+
+两句话描述的是同一次“跳过 A 往前走”，结果必然相同。代码中的单元测试 `first_successor_becomes_owner_when_the_owner_is_removed` 对每个区间都验证了这一点。
+
+更一般地，**移除一个节点，对任何副本列表的影响都是：把该节点从列表中删掉，后面的节点依次前移一位，再在末尾补上顺时针的下一个节点。** 以上面的例子来看：
+
+| 受影响的区间 | 移除 A 前 | 移除 A 后 | 需要补数据的节点 |
+| --- | --- | --- | --- |
+| A 的区间（并入 `(10, 40]`） | **A**, B, C | B, C, D | D（只缺原属 A 的部分） |
+| B 的区间（并入 `(10, 40]`） | B, C, D | B, C, D | 无 |
+| P 的区间 `(…, 10]` | P, **A**, B | P, B, C | C（新补到末尾的节点） |
+
+前移的节点原本就持有这部分数据，只是换了一个位置；真正缺数据的，只有补到列表末尾的那一个节点。（计划内缩容时，前移节点经验证的准入可以直接带入新拓扑；故障时则需在后台重新验证，见第 6 节。）
+
+## 3. 为什么“并入”不需要搬数据
+
+每个数据节点只有一张内存记录表（`records`），自己作为 owner 负责的键和作为 follower 复制来的键存在同一张表里，并不按角色分开存放。节点是 owner 还是 follower，完全由它当前安装的拓扑决定。
+
+因此，B 从“A 的区间的第一个 follower”变成“合并区间的 owner”，不需要复制、导入或转换任何数据。新拓扑一装上，B 就开始用它早已持有的记录为这些键服务。这就是“follower 的数据并入下一个 owner 的管辖范围”的含义：变化的只是拓扑中的归属关系，数据原地不动。
+
+对比扩容：新节点加入时，它在所有相关区间中都不持有数据，必须经过快照复制、增量回放、短暂停写和校验。缩容和故障接管则把这一步省掉了，或者推迟到后台去做。
+
+## 4. 前提：必须证明新 owner 的数据是完整的
+
+“第一个 follower 持有数据”只是结构上的预期，实际不一定成立。例如：
+
+- follower 刚加入集群，初始快照还没复制完；
+- follower 与 owner 之间的连接断过，复制流有缺口；
+- 区间合并后，新 owner 只覆盖了其中一部分子区间。
+
+所以系统把“应该在哪里”和“确实准备好了”分开记录。Coordinator 为每个 follower 持久化一条**准入（admission）记录**，绑定拓扑 epoch、精确的区间边界、节点和进程实例，只有在快照和连续的增量历史都经过验证后才写入。
+
+接管时，Coordinator 会检查合并后区间的**每一个组成部分**：新 owner 要么原本就是这部分的 owner，要么是这部分的第一个 follower，**并且**持有这部分的准入记录。任何一部分不满足，都不会发布新拓扑，**不完整的副本永远不会被提升**。
+
+## 5. 计划内缩容
+
+当目标拓扑只是删除节点、不同时修改其他配置时，Coordinator 走这条“自然继承”（代码中称为 direct merge）路径：
+
+1. **检查结构条件。** 确认每个合并区间的新 owner 都是各组成部分的原 owner 或第一个 follower，且当前写入策略要求的 follower 在结构上都已持有数据。
+2. **补齐缺失的准入（如有）。** 若某个必需的 follower 还没有准入记录，先在后台完成补种。这一步在停写之前进行，不影响服务。
+3. **短暂暂停写入。** 读请求照常进行。
+4. **等待复制流追平。** 对每一对“旧 owner → 新 owner”以及策略要求的 follower，等待 follower 已应用的序号追上 owner 已发出的序号。离开的节点仍在线，所以它最后的写入可以全部发出去。
+5. **再次验证。** 确认覆盖关系和租约在停写期间没有变化。
+6. **发布新 epoch。** 已追平的 follower 的准入记录直接带入新拓扑。
+7. **激活、清理与停止。** 各节点安装新拓扑后恢复写入；不再需要的副本被删除，最后才停止离开的节点。
+8. **后台补齐副本数。** 列表末尾新补上的节点通过快照加增量获得数据。
+
+在仓库记录的 20 次连续测试中（9 ↔ 10 个节点，RF=3，`FirstSuccessor`，20,000 个键，迁移期间持续写入），需要复制数据的扩容耗时中位数为 7.958 秒，而缩容为 0.595 秒（最小 0.568 秒，最大 0.616 秒）。这是本地、小规模的测量，只说明两种路径的量级差别，不代表百万键规模下的迁移性能。
+
+## 6. 故障接管
+
+故障时离开的节点已经无法配合，流程有三点不同：
+
+1. **确认故障。** 节点的租约已过期即可确认；否则需要至少两个独立节点持续报告它不可达。只有一对节点之间互相连不通时，系统不会贸然驱逐任何一方。
+2. **隔离旧 owner。** Coordinator 停止为它续约，并**等到它的租约一定已经过期**。租约过期的节点会自行停止服务，所以此后不可能有两个 owner 同时接受写入。
+3. **证明覆盖。** 与缩容相同，新 owner 必须对每个组成部分持有准入记录。
+4. **发布新 epoch。** 无法再“追平”故障节点，所以没有停写和等待追平这两步。
+5. **读先恢复，写按策略恢复。** 新拓扑安装、租约生效后读即恢复；写何时恢复取决于写入策略（见下表）。
+6. **后台修复。** 准入记录绑定拓扑 epoch 和复制流，当前实现在故障路径下不把任何旧准入带入新拓扑，所以新拓扑中的 follower（包括前移的节点，以及未受故障影响的区间的 follower）都要通过后台修复，以快照加增量重新复制并验证后才能重新准入。服务恢复只依赖新 owner 已持有的数据，读取不等待这些修复；但 `FirstSuccessor` 和 `AllReplicas` 下的写入要等所需的 follower 重新准入。
+
+| 写入策略 | 故障时会不会丢已确认的写入 | 接管后写入何时恢复 |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| `OwnerOnly`（默认） | 可能：旧 owner 已确认但尚未复制出去的尾部写入会丢失 | 满足最低副本要求后立即恢复 |
+| `FirstSuccessor` | 从健康状态出发，单节点故障不丢：每次确认前，下一任 owner 已经应用了这次写入 | 新的第一个 follower 追平并准入之后 |
+| `AllReplicas` | 不丢 | 全部期望副本就绪之后 |
+
+`FirstSuccessor` 的设计正是建立在第 2 节的观察之上：既然接管者是确定的，只要让它在确认前先收到写入，就能保证故障后已确认的写入不丢失。要求“任意两个副本确认”则做不到这一点：如果确认的是第二个 follower，而接管的是第一个 follower，这次写入仍会丢。

-### 已实现

-- 场景：`round-trip` / `grow` / `shrink` / `replace`（S3 等成员数替换）/ `churn`（S4 多节点连续迁移）/ `control`（S0 无迁移对照）。

-### 局限
-
-- 共享桌面主机，桌面进程同时运行；本轮桌面负载更高（`loadavg` 约 5），绝对吞吐低于更早的 `d0b160f` 记录（主组 grow `complete_ms` 2772 vs 1855），重复运行的波动同样受它影响。
-- S3/S4/诊断/策略组各只有 1 次重复，只能作为量级参考，不能当作分布。
-- 开环组在 RF 修复窗口出现负载丢弃，说明“稳态容量 60%”在修复期并不成立；容量基线只在无迁移、无修复的稳态下测得。
-- 计划 §5 中列为可选的“原始 owner RPC 探针”没有做：阻塞时长以客户端观测的 `RangeBusy` 窗口和按阶段的写延迟报告，没有把传输与重试等待分开。原始 `results/` 只有本机，不作为共享基线。
-- 开环组的一次性写入池必须覆盖整个 transition，包括下一个 transition 开始前对上一个 transition 的延迟校验。这个校验在满载下很慢（1M 键约 43 s），所以开环组对主机负载非常敏感：本轮在忙的主机上 3 次都被判 invalid。100k 键下池窗口只允许数千 ops/s（低于容量的 10%）。它的 post 窗口是 5 s（主组 10 s），以便池覆盖整个 transition。
-- 统计功效：每次运行零失败不能推出失败率上界；可用性只报告观察值（本轮闭环运行 0 失败）。

-| `direct_merge` 要求目标成员数**严格减少**，且目标成员全部来自旧成员 | `crates/hashring-coordinator/src/merge.rs:14` | S2 缩容可走；S3 同时增删**一定不走** |
-| 走 `direct_merge` 时清空 `change.ranges` | `crates/hashring-coordinator/src/rpc.rs:443` | 没有快照复制，但仍有停写、追平、发布阶段 |
-| `direct_merge` 依次经过 `PausingWrites` → `Verifying` → `ReadyToPublish`；写栅栏在 `PausingWrites` 加上并保持到发布；`Verifying` 等待旧复制流追平 | `crates/hashring-coordinator/src/merge.rs:334-391` | S2 全集群停写的主要耗时在 `Verifying`；该阶段必须标为适用 |
-| `direct_merge` 会对**所有旧成员**加写栅栏 | `crates/hashring-coordinator/src/merge.rs:337` | 缩容时未迁移的键也可能被停写，“不动键”不能当对照组 |
-| `ReplayingChangelog` 设置后立刻进入 `PausingWrites` | `crates/hashring-coordinator/src/change.rs:123` | 该阶段无法用轮询观测；回放工作实际发生在 `CopyingSnapshot` / `Verifying` 内部 |
-| `pre_publish_delay` 在 `ReadyToPublish` 且写已暂停后 sleep，两条路径都生效 | `crates/hashring-coordinator/src/change.rs:179`、`merge.rs:393` | 默认 250 ms 会人为拉长停写；direct merge 时停的是**整个集群**的写，性能组必须设 0 |
-| 发布后 `finish_published_change` 重新计算 `migration_timeout` | `crates/hashring-coordinator/src/change.rs:807` | 不能把它当作整个实验的总期限 |
-| `correctness` 模式已实现 9→10→9 的编排：初始节点少于峰值、`begin-change` 后启动新节点、等待被移除节点退出 | `crates/hashring-experiment/src/lib.rs:848` | 应扩展现有流程，而不是从零写一套 |
-| 客户端已区分 `KnownNotApplied` 与 `MayHaveApplied` | `crates/hashring-client/src/lib.rs:127` | 最终校验必须按操作类型和结果分别定义允许终态 |
-| 可重试错误码还包括 `TemporarilyUnavailable`、`ReplicaNotReady`、`OutcomeUnknown` | `crates/hashring-client/src/lib.rs:916` | 重试原因列表需补全 |
-| 现客户端只有总 `retry_count`，且包含拓扑刷新 | `crates/hashring-client/src/lib.rs:324` | 需要按原因/通道拆分统计 |
-
-S2 是否真的走 `direct_merge` 还取决于 `can_direct_merge` 的 `merge_proof`；主配置（RF=3、`OwnerOnly`、副本健康）下预期走，若不满足会退回复制路径。运行时记录实际路径，不能预设。
-

-
-## 3. 场景
-
-主配置：**RF=3、`OwnerOnly`、`minimum_admitted_copies=1`、`minimum_healthy_followers=0`、30 s 期限**。`FirstSuccessor` 作为对照。
-
-| 场景 | 拓扑变化 | 实际路径 | 主要观察 |
-|---|---|---|---|
-| **S1 扩容** | 9 → 10，新增 node-10 | 复制：快照 + changelog 回放 | 读连续性；切写时 `RangeBusy` 的比例与持续时长；复制与负载争用；发布后 RF 修复 |
-| **S2 缩容** | 10 → 9，移除 node-10 | 主配置下预期 `direct_merge`：无快照复制，但仍有 `PausingWrites`/`Verifying`；所有旧成员写栅栏，停写覆盖全集群 | 全集群写停顿长度（主要在 `Verifying` 追平旧复制流）；未迁移键是否也被停写；在途请求结果；被移除节点退出；键是否丢失/复活 |
-| S3 替换（已实现） | 10 → 10，移除 node-10、加入 node-11 | **一定走复制路径**，被移除节点的区间也要复制 | 正式运行待排；峰值是 11 个同时存活的数据进程 |
-| S4 连续迁移（已实现） | 6 → 9 → 6 | 多区间并发迁移 | 正式运行待排；背靠背 change、epoch 抖动、累计影响 |
-| **S0 对照（已实现）** | 不变 | 无 | 相同负载与时长下的自然波动，作为 S1/S2 的基线 |
-
-S1 与 S2 在**同一个集群生命周期内连续执行**：预载一次、负载不中断，先扩容再缩容。这样与 TODO #3 的 9→10→9 一致，也避免两套环境差异。S3/S4 单独运行。
-
-两次迁移之间的状态衔接有三条硬性规定：
-
-1. **S1 完成后先做局部 drain 和校验，再开始 S2**。S1 的 `Complete` 和完整 RF 之后：
-   - 停止发放 S1 批次的写/删请求；
-   - 等待 S1 cohort 的在途逻辑操作全部返回（只针对 S1 的局部 drain，不是全局停止负载）；
-   - 按 §4.2 校验 S1 动过的 cohort。
-
-   这段时间主负载继续使用 S2 的预备批次，负载本身不用停；S1 的在途计数要按批次跟踪，确定归零后才能冻结 S1 台账。不能只做最后一次全量校验，否则无法区分违规来自哪次迁移。现有 `correctness` 流程本来就在两次迁移之间做校验（`lib.rs` 约 921–942 行），但它是停掉整个写负载后校验，本方案要改成局部 drain。
-2. **S2 使用独立的 cohort 池**。S1 中结果为 `MayHaveApplied` 的键，终态是一个集合（如 `{v0, v1}`），不能拿来当 S2 的 `v0`，必须从 S2 的所有池中排除。
-3. **S2 的分层标签以 S1 完成后的拓扑为 base 重新计算**，不能沿用 S1 的 `owner_changed` / `new_target` 等标签。S2 的 base 是 10 节点拓扑，target 是 9 节点拓扑。
-
----
-
-## 4. 键空间、期望状态与分层
-
-核心原则：每个键的期望终态由**操作类型 + 客户端结果**唯一决定；读写之间不产生无法判定的竞争。
-
-### 4.1 cohort 与负载操作
-
-| cohort | 迁移前 | 负载期间 | 目的 |
-|---|---|---|---|
-| `read` | 已存在，值 `v0` | 只 GET | 读连续性、丢键、错值 |
-| `rewrite` | 已存在，值 `v0` | 每键 PUT 一次到 `v1` | 检测丢失覆盖写 |
-| `write_new` | 不存在 | 每键 PUT 一次到 `v1` | 检测丢失新写 |
-| `delete` | 已存在，值 `v0` | 每键 DELETE 一次 | 检测删除丢失/复活 |
-
-`read` 与 `delete` 池不相交；`read` 池在整个负载期间不变，任意时刻读到非 `v0` 或 `NotFound` 都直接判失败。
-
-### 4.2 最终校验的允许终态
-
-| 操作 | 成功 | `MayHaveApplied`（结果未知） | `KnownNotApplied`（明确未应用） |
-|---|---|---|---|
-| `rewrite` | `v1` | `{v0, v1}` | `v0` |
-| `write_new` | `v1` | `{不存在, v1}` | 不存在 |
-| `delete` | 不存在 | `{v0, 不存在}` | `v0` |
-| `read` | `v0` | — | — |
-
-全量校验也按这张表执行。停止发新请求后先执行 **drain**：等待所有在途逻辑操作返回，冻结成功写台账与各操作结果，再做最终校验，避免把仍在途的请求误判为失败。
-
-### 4.3 分层标签
-
-不要用“完全不动的键”当单一对照组。每个 cohort 按以下标签分层，并分别统计**实际打到的操作数**：
-
-- `owner_changed`：owner 变了（会迁移）
-- `replicas_changed`：owner 未变，但副本集合变了
-- `removed_source`：base owner 是被移除节点
-- `new_target`：目标 owner 是新增节点
-- `unchanged`：owner 和副本集合都没变（真正的对照）
-
-`read` 使用 `zipf:0.99`，热点未必落在迁移区间，因此必须记录每层实际完成的操作数；每层样本不足时不能外推结论。可复用现有 `moving_key_cohorts` / `moving_keys`（`crates/hashring-experiment/src/lib.rs` 约 1983 行）。
-
-每个场景**适用的分层**不同，有效性只针对适用层，空层是“不适用”而不是“无样本”：
-
-| 场景 | owner_changed | replicas_changed | removed_source | new_target | unchanged |
-|---|---|---|---|---|---|
-| S1 扩容 | 适用 | 适用 | 不适用（无移除节点） | 适用 | 适用 |
-| S2 缩容 | 适用 | 适用 | 适用 | 不适用（无新增节点） | 适用 |
-| S0 对照 | 不适用 | 不适用 | 不适用 | 不适用 | 适用 |
-| S3 替换（延后） | 适用 | 适用 | 适用 | 适用 | 适用 |
-
-### 4.4 读己之写 / 读己之删（必做）
-
-对每个成功的 `write_new`、`rewrite`、`delete`，由**同一个写入者按顺序**对同一个键做一次 GET，校验：
-
-- 写后读必须返回新值；
-- 删后读必须 `NotFound`；
-- 重点覆盖正在迁移的键，用于检测“切换后从旧 owner 读到旧值”和“已删键短暂复活”。
-
-单写入者串行操作，不会引入同键并发竞争。该检查从“可选”改为必做，否则结论只能收窄为“不变键读连续性 + 写删最终状态”。
-
-**发布后复读（同样必做）**：只在写完立刻读一次抓不到最主要的风险。“切换后从旧 owner 读到旧值”的窗口在发布前后：一个键若在发布前写入，写完马上读到的仍是旧 owner，无法暴露切换后的问题。因此对 `owner_changed` 层中在每次 `Published` 之前写过/删过的键，在 `Published` 之后（以及 `Complete` 之后）各复读一次。只复读 `begin-change` 之后改动过的键，不要复读整个历史。客户端按缓存拓扑路由，遇到 `Moved` 会刷新并重试，最终由当前 owner 回答，所以这次复读的结果可判定；记录写入 epoch、复读 epoch 与结果，按阶段分别统计。
-
-**探针 GET 必须与主负载分开统计**：读己之写/删和发布后复读打的是被改写或删除的键，这些键均匀分布；主负载的 `read` 是 Zipf 分布。两者混进同一个 GET 直方图会让读延迟失真，也会让实际混合比例偏离 80:15:5。因此：
-
-- 给探针单独打标签（如 `probe_read_after_write`、`probe_read_after_publish`）、单独建直方图，不进入主 GET 统计；实际比例单独报告。
-- 发布后复读要限速，或使用单独的 client 和独立并发额度，避免在 `Published → Complete` 这个本来就要测延迟的窗口打出一波突发。建议上限为同时段主 GET 速率的一个小比例（如 5%），并记录实际复读速率和数量。
-
----
-
-## 5. 负载与 cohort 预算
-
-一次性池子与“持续混合负载”会冲突：预热 + 基线期间可能就把有限的改写/新写/删除样本用完。必须明确四件事：
-
-1. **操作比例**：建议 GET:PUT:DELETE 约 80:15:5；其中 PUT 再分为 `rewrite` 与 `write_new`。实际比例单独统计，不拿配置值冒充。
-2. **池的大小**：按“目标速率 × 预计总时长 × 安全系数”生成；`write_new` 预留独立键段，绝不与已用键冲突。
-3. **发放方式**：按时间窗口分批发放；**给迁移窗口预留专用批次**，在 `begin-change` 之后才释放。删除池按同样方式分批。
-4. **用完后行为**：在最后一次 `Complete` 之前，任何一个池用完都判整次运行 **invalid**，不能“停掉该 cohort 继续跑”。否则迁移后半段的混合比例与 S0 对照及其他重复运行不同，延迟不可直接比较。池按预计最长时长加安全系数生成；不得复用键写入不同值。
-
-负载形态：
-
-| 形态 | 参数 | 用途 |
-|---|---|---|
-| **闭环（主）** | 并发 64，完整 30 s 期限与重试 | 回答“是否持续服务”。注意：一遇停顿闭环就会少发请求，**并不能免除协调遗漏**，只能减轻。 |
-| **开环（复核）** | `--scaling-load-mode open --scaling-open-rate <rate>`；固定速率；目标速率 = 特定策略/拓扑/混合比例下测得的稳态容量的 60%，`--max-in-flight 4096` | 回答“给定 offered load 下的真实尾延迟”。必须写明容量基线来自哪组配置。 |
-
-开环按总量 80:15:5 发放 GET:PUT:DELETE，PUT 再分 60/25/15；池按 `--scaling-pool-seconds` 与该写入速率生成。`late`（驱动发不出去）与 `errors`（集群返回失败）分开报告，不能混为一谈；延迟从请求到期时刻开始计，不从事后实际发出的时刻开始。
-
-**复用边界**：`latency.rs` 只复用直方图和固定速率调度器；不能复用请求执行器，因为它随机选键、PUT 固定写 round 0、删除键可能被重复选中、GET 返回值被丢弃，不满足台账要求。迁移观察必须挂在**同一段不中断的负载**上，不能按阶段重置统计或排空请求。
-
-可选**原始 owner RPC 探针**：绕过客户端重试，直接向迁移中区间的 owner 发 PUT/GET，测出真实切写阻塞时长；否则重试会把停顿“抹平”。
-
----
-
-## 6. 单场景时间线
-
-```
-启动 9 个节点（S1）→ 预载 100k 键 → 等待目标 epoch 的完整 RF
-→ 启动持续负载 → 预热 10 s → 记录基线窗口 10 s
-→ begin-change（10 成员）→ 启动 node-10 → 等待监听
-→ execute-change，负载不停
-→ 等待 Published → activation_ready → Complete → 完整 RF
-→ 记录迁移后窗口
-→ 停止发放 S1 批次 → 等待 S1 cohort 在途请求返回（局部 drain）
-→ 按 §4.2 校验 S1 cohort（S2 预备批次继续跑）
-→ 以 10 节点拓扑重新计算 S2 分层，准备 S2 独立池
-→ begin-change（回到 9 成员）→ execute-change，负载不停
-→ 等待 Published / Complete / 被移除节点退出 / 完整 RF
-→ 记录迁移后窗口 → 停止发新请求 → drain → 冻结台账 → 全量校验
-```
-
-每个 change 都单独记录五个时间点；S1 与 S2 不合并计时。
-
-**时间点要分开记录五个**：开始执行、发布（Published）、`activation_ready`、`Complete`、首次与稳定达到完整 RF。RF 修复不是 `MigrationPhase`，不能塞进阶段统计。`wait_for_full_rf` 需要增加**目标 epoch 检查**，避免读到旧拓扑的“已满 RF”。实现上每个 transition 写 `published_ms`、`complete_ms`、`full_rf_seconds`，与 `work_steps_ms` 的 `publish_ms`/`activation_ms` 一起给出这五个点。
-
-**阶段边界精度**：轮询间隔决定边界误差（建议 2–5 ms），报告中要写明。`migration_timeout` 会在发布后重新计时，实验本身另设总期限。
-
-**延迟归因**：按请求**发起时**所在的阶段统计；开始和结束跨越阶段的请求单独展示。按完成时间归因会把停写期间的停顿算到发布之后。
-
-**`pre_publish_delay_ms`**：主性能组显式设为 **0**。该延迟在复制路径与 direct merge 路径上都生效（`change.rs:179`、`merge.rs:393`）；S2 走 direct merge 时，它停的是**整个集群**的写，不只是迁移区间，所以 delay=0 对 S2 更重要。带 250 ms 延迟的运行只作为诊断组，单列，不与主组比较写延迟。delay=0 是主组的**运行前提**（见 §9），不列为通过标准。
-
----
-
-## 7. 指标与阶段适用性
-
-### 7.1 阶段适用性
-
-不再使用“每阶段至少 1000 次成功操作”的统一门槛，改为逐阶段标记 **适用 / 不适用 / 未观测**：
-
-| 阶段 | S1 扩容 | S2 缩容（direct merge） | 应看到的证据 |
-|---|---|---|---|
-| `CopyingSnapshot` | 适用 | 不适用 | 读成功；写成功或可重试拒绝 |
-| `ReplayingChangelog` | 瞬时，基本观测不到 | 不适用 | 不单独判定；回放耗时由 coordinator 工作步骤计时的 `changelog_replay_ms` 给出 |
-| `PausingWrites` | 适用 | 适用 | **写请求尝试并被 `RangeBusy` 拒绝**，不要求成功写 |
-| `Verifying` | 适用 | **适用** | 写被 `RangeBusy` 拒绝、读成功；S2 的停写主要耗时在这里（等旧复制流追平） |
-| `ReadyToPublish` | 适用（delay=0） | 适用（delay=0） | 读成功；S2 的写仍被栅栏拒绝 |
-| `Published → Complete` | 适用 | 适用 | 读写恢复；移除节点退出 |
-
-停写窗口的正确证据是“有写尝试且被拒绝”，不是“有大量成功写”；S2 不走复制路径，不能要求 `CopyingSnapshot` 有样本，但 `Verifying` 必须适用。
-
-若要拆分复制、回放、校验各自的成本，**光看 phase 不够**。协调器现在在每次 change 上记录工作步骤耗时，随 `TopologyChangeSnapshot.timings` 返回，实验写进 `<label>_transition.work_steps_ms`：
-
-| 字段 | 含义 |
-|---|---|
-| `snapshot_copy_ms` | 所有 range 的 snapshot 复制（含 dedup）耗时之和，不含该 range 的 changelog 回放；并发迁移时可能大于 `CopyingSnapshot` 阶段墙钟 |
-| `changelog_replay_ms` | 所有 range 的 `replay_changelog` 耗时之和；不含之后的 digest 往返与 destination commit（它们属于 `verify_ms`）；并发迁移时可能大于所在阶段 |
-| `pause_writes_ms` | `PausingWrites` 阶段墙钟（direct merge 时含加栅栏；policy change 时含向每个成员发暂停栅栏） |
-| `verify_ms` | `Verifying` 阶段墙钟（复制路径含最终回放、digest 与提交；policy change 含等待 follower 追平的屏障） |
-| `publish_ms` | 提交新拓扑的工作耗时（目标实例校验、状态锁与一致性检查），不含 `pre_publish_delay` 观测窗，也不含承载该计时的这次持久化写本身 |
-| `activation_ms` | 提交后 activation/RF repair 屏障与目标拓扑安装；不含清理 source range、停被移除节点和 `post_publish_delay` |
-| `merge_proof_ms` | direct merge 的 coverage/proof 计算 |
-| `catch_up_ms` | direct merge 等旧复制流追平的循环 |
-
-这些是 coordinator 侧的墙钟，不含客户端重试等待，也不含 `wait_for_full_rf` 在 `Complete` 之后的收敛时间。字段为 0 表示该路径不经过这一步（例如 S2 direct merge 的 `snapshot_copy_ms`/`changelog_replay_ms`）。计时与阶段变更在同一次持久化写中落库：发布时 `publish_ms` 随 `Published` 阶段一起写入，activation 之后 `activation_ms` 随 `CleaningUp`/`Complete` 一起写入；发布之前的已完成步骤随下一阶段一起落库，direct merge 的 proof 计时在证明完成后写入，因此状态查询和被 abort 的 change 都保留已测步骤。中断重试在清理期间保留计时，真正开始新一轮复制时清空上一轮计时。因此 `change-status`、重复的 `execute-change`、以及重启后从 redb 读到的记录，都和 `execute-change` 的返回值一致；不存在"阶段已落库、计时还没写"的窗口。另外 `<label>_transition` 还有 `published_ms`、`published_ms_source`、`complete_ms`、`full_rf_seconds`：前两个从 change 开始计时，`full_rf_seconds` 从 `Complete`（含之后等被移除节点退出的时间）到目标 epoch 满 RF。短 change 可能从 `Verifying` 直接跳到 `Complete`，此时探针仍会启动，`published_ms` 取完成时刻，`published_ms_source` 记为 `completion_fallback`，正常观测到发布时为 `observed`。
-
-恢复路径的 `activation_ms` 只覆盖"恢复时的重做"：在 `Published`/`CleaningUp` 恢复的 change 不会重测发布，`publish_ms` 保持首次发布写入的值；`activation_ms` 度量的是重新安装与重新激活，而不是原始 activation。租约等待也不计入（它是一段安全等待）。

-### 7.2 负载指标
-
-- 尝试数、成功数、失败数（应用层 `ErrorCode` / gRPC status / 连接失败 / 拓扑刷新分开）
-- 重试原因：`Moved`、`RangeBusy`、`Unavailable`、`ResourceExhausted`、`TemporarilyUnavailable`、`ReplicaNotReady`、`OutcomeUnknown`、`LeaseExpired`、`Rpc`（传输层状态）、`Connect`（建连失败）、`TopologyRefresh`
-- 主负载 GET、PUT、DELETE 的 p50/p95/p99/max 与 `max_observed`；探针 GET（读己之写/删、发布后复读）单独直方图，不并入主负载
-- 每秒窗口：`epoch`、`issued`、`late`、`achieved_rate`、in-flight
-- 切写窗口的写尝试数、拒绝数、停写时长；首个成功写时间
-- **停写窗口的定义以客户端实际观测为准**：按区间（S2 是全集群）记录第一次和最后一次 `RangeBusy` 的时间，再取此后第一个成功写，用这三者定义窗口；phase 只做粗粒度标注。栅栏在节点收到 RPC 后才生效，与 coordinator 的 phase 切换存在时差，再叠加轮询误差，不能拿阶段边界当停写时长。实现上由 scaling 模式每 5 ms 采样客户端的 `RangeBusy` 计数与成功写计数；每次成功写记录的是**发起这次写之前**客户端已经看到的拒绝计数（不是写完成后的计数），所以一个在停写开始时就已在途的写不会把它关闭窗口；`busy_before_first_ok` 就是关闭窗口那次写开始时的拒绝计数，是 `first_write_ok_ms` 的证据。写入 `<label>_transition.stop_window`（`first_range_busy_ms`、`last_range_busy_ms`、`first_write_ok_ms`、`busy_before_first_ok`、`observed_ms`、`poll_ms`）。每个 transition 的窗口以它开始时的累计计数为基线，所以第二个 transition 不会把第一个的拒绝算成自己的，`first_range_busy_ms` 也不会被钉成 0。
-- 发布后复读在观察到 `Published` 的那一刻启动（限速、独立 client），不是整个 transition 结束后的一次终态复查，否则发布瞬间的短暂陈旧读会自愈、探针看不到。
-- 发布后复读必须真的读到键。探针等待的是"持续有进展"而不是固定时长：每次读都受客户端 operation timeout 限制，所以一个还在读的探针一定会在该时限内完成一个键；连续 `operation timeout + 间隔 + 10 s` 没有新键才算卡住。空闲时钟从探针启动时起算（不是从运行等待探针时起算），读到一个键就把截止时间往后推同样的时长，所以早期就卡住的探针会在运行结束前被放弃。`scaling_after_publish_probe_started` 事件记录 `idle_limit_ms`；卡住时记 `scaling_after_publish_probe_stuck`（含已核验的键数）并让运行失败。只有值匹配或确认预期的缺失才推进读取数；GET 失败、意外缺失或错误值都会使探针和运行失败，即使后续终态复核恢复也不算通过。每个 change 的探针读取数写入 `scaling_after_publish_probes.keys_read`；读取数为 0（发布窗口内没有落到迁移分层的成功写）即判该次运行 invalid，而不是当作"没有违规"。
-- 重试总数与按原因计数必须对得上：`retry_count()` 等于 `retry_reasons()` 之和。建连失败记 `Connect`，可重试的 gRPC 状态记 `Rpc`，两者不再合并。
-- 开环组的实际写入速率来自 `--scaling-open-rate` 的分层拆分，`scaling_pool_plan.cohort_write_rates` 记录 rewrite/new/delete 各自的实际速率；`write_rate` 在开环下为 `null`，因为 `--scaling-write-rate` 在开环下不生效。分层拆分是整除（闭环 60/25/15，开环 12/5/3），所以 `cohort_write_rates.total` 可能比配置值略小（例如 `--scaling-write-rate 50` 实际是 30+12+7=49）；`write_rate` 记的是配置值，`cohort_write_rates` 记的是取整后的实际值。最小的一层必须至少分到 1 次操作/秒，否则该 cohort 没有键；这一点在参数校验阶段就会拒绝（闭环最小 `--scaling-write-rate 7`，开环最小 `--scaling-open-rate 34`，按最小份额 15% 与 3% 取整算出）。速率上限 1,000,000 次/秒、`--scaling-pool-seconds` 上限 86,400、`--keys` 上限 100,000,000，都是参数校验阶段就拒绝，保证池大小（速率 × 秒数）、键空间（键数 × 份额）等乘积不会溢出，而不是等到集群启动、change 已 staged 之后才 panic。
-- 读连续失败最长间隔
-- 每层 cohort 的实际操作量与结果分布
-- 每次 change 的迁移量：`<label>_transition.migration` 的 `keys`、`keys_moved`、`rate`、`ranges`、`snapshot_records`
-- 每节点 owner 操作计数、CPU、owned keys/ranges，观察负载转移
-
-### 7.3 正确性指标
-
-- 按 cohort × 分层标签：缺失、错值、复活删除的计数
-- 成功写/删台账（键、值、操作结果、返回版本、epoch）
-- `MayHaveApplied` / `KnownNotApplied` 分别归类，不混入成功台账

-## 8. 通过标准
-
-**运行有效性（不满足判 `invalid`，不判 pass/fail）**
-
-1. 主组 `pre_publish_delay_ms = 0`（运行前提，见 §9）。
-2. 在最后一次 `Complete` 之前没有任何 cohort 池耗尽。
-3. 整个迁移窗口内，**该场景适用的**每个分层都有实际操作样本（适用层见 §4.3；不适用层不计入判定）。
-4. 停写窗口内至少有**一次写请求被 `RangeBusy` 拒绝**。
-5. 阶段 × 分层的覆盖情况只报告，不作为判定条件。S1 的 `PausingWrites` 可能只有几毫秒，`read` 又是 Zipf 分布，要求每个适用阶段 × 每个分层都有样本大概率会误判 `inconclusive`。
-
-**硬性（可判 pass/fail）**
-
-1. change 正常完成并发布，未进入 `Aborted`。
-2. 正确性违规为 0：按 §4.2 的允许终态逐项成立，包括 S1 后的中间校验与每次 `Published` 后的复读。
-3. 所有进程无意外退出；被移除节点在宽限期内正常退出。
-
-**软性（报告，不单独作为“持续可用”的证明）**
-
-- 读/写成功率、`deadline` 数、p50/p95/p99、重试原因分布
-- 停写窗口长度、`RangeBusy` 比例、首个成功读写时间
-- 五个时间点与完整 RF 恢复时间
-- S1 后 owned keys 的最大/均值、每节点负载转移
-- 与 S0 对照运行的差值
-
-注意统计功效：1000 次零失败**不能**推出失败率 < 0.1%。可用性结论只能写成“在该负载与样本量下观察到 X 次失败”，不能写成“持续可用”。若要支撑严格失败率，需要显著增加样本量或按二项分布给出置信区间。

-## 9. 运行矩阵
-
-| 组 | 场景 | 策略 | 负载 | 键数 | 重复 | 备注 |
-|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
-| 主组 | S1→S2 往返 | OwnerOnly | 闭环 | 100k | 3 | `pre_publish_delay=0` |
-| 对照 | S0 不迁移 | OwnerOnly | 闭环，同时长 | 100k | 3 | 区分自然波动 |
-| 诊断 | S1→S2 往返 | OwnerOnly | 闭环 | 100k | 1 | `pre_publish_delay=250`，只诊断 |
-| 策略对照 | S1→S2 往返 | FirstSuccessor | 闭环 | 100k | 1 | 量化等待 follower 的代价 |
-| 尾延迟 | S1→S2 往返 | OwnerOnly | 开环 60% 容量 | 1M | 3 | 容量与速率见 §0.1 |
-| 替换 | S3 替换 | OwnerOnly | 闭环 | 100k | 1 | 峰值 11 个数据进程 |
-| 连续迁移 | S4 6→9→6 | OwnerOnly | 闭环 | 100k | 1 | 多区间并发迁移 |
-| 大规模 | S1→S2 往返 | OwnerOnly | 闭环 | 1M | 1 | §0.1 的 1M 主组 |

-- 每次运行全新集群、独立输出目录；正式运行 `--require-clean-source`；主组 seed=1，方差大时补 seed=2。矩阵入口是 `scripts/scaling-matrix.sh`。
-- 100k 键、闭环 200 写/秒时每个 transition 只有 25k 可写键，`--scaling-pool-seconds` 取 120 留出约 1.4 倍余量；开环高得多的写速率要用更短的池窗口，否则池在 change 完成前就会耗尽并判 invalid。
-- worker 线程预算按**同时存活的数据进程峰值**计算：S1/S2 是 10，S3 是 11。端口也一样。
-- 机器上不跑其他负载；对照组的节点数、线程预算与主组一致（本次主机是共享桌面机，见 §0.1 局限）。
-- cohort 池按“预计最长时长 × 安全系数”生成；最后一次 `Complete` 前耗尽即判该次运行 invalid，不进入统计。

-## 11. 风险与混杂因素
-
-- **S2 全集群写栅栏**：未迁移的键也可能停写，`unchanged` 层不是安全对照；必须实际测量，而不是假设。
-- **S3 一定复制**，且峰值 11 个数据进程；预算和端口按 11 算，不能按 10 算。
-- **阶段轮询分辨率**：`ReplayingChangelog` 看不到，边界只能精确到轮询间隔；coordinator 工作步骤计时已提供更细的回放/校验成本，但 `changelog_replay_ms` 是并发 range 之和，不能当作墙钟。S2 的停写时长以客户端观测到的 `RangeBusy` 为准，不以阶段边界为准。
-- **单机共享 CPU**：复制、digest 与负载争用；worker 预算固定。
-- **客户端重试掩盖停顿**：逻辑延迟包含重试等待；原始 owner RPC 探针用于分离真实阻塞。
-- **开环 `late` vs `errors`**：容量不足导致的丢弃不等于集群错误。
-- **开环下 `range_busy` 可能为 0**：低速开环下若没有写请求命中停写窗口，§8 的有效性检查会判 invalid；这不代表迁移错误。本次 50k ops/s 的开环组每次都有 8k+ 次拒绝，没有触发该情况。
-- **开环一次性写入池**：池的键来自预载键空间，一个 transition 的池必须撑满整个 transition（预热、change、满 RF、post 窗口），因此高 offered rate 需要大键空间；100k 键下最多只有数千 ops/s。
-- **统计功效**：小样本零失败不能证明低失败率；可用性只作观察值。
-- **协调器单点**：本实验不验证协调器 HA。

+这一轮的计时口径有三处修正，因此 `replay`、`满 RF s`、`停写窗口 ms` 三列与 `d0b160f` 的记录不可比：`changelog_replay_ms` 只算回放本身（不再把 digest 往返与 commit 算进去），`full_rf_seconds` 从 `Complete` 起算（含等被移除节点退出），停写窗口以每个 transition 开始时的计数为基线（第二个 transition 不再把第一个的拒绝算成自己的）。

+> **上一轮之后的计时口径修正**：`publish_ms` 现在覆盖发布工作一直到承载它的那次持久化写之前，写本身不计入；policy 路径也测量 `pause_writes_ms`、`verify_ms`、`publish_ms` 与 `activation_ms`；计时与阶段变更在同一次持久化写中落库。下表是修正之前的口径，只作为量级参考。

+### 已实现
+
+- 场景：`round-trip` / `grow` / `shrink` / `replace`（S3 等成员数替换）/ `churn`（S4 多节点连续迁移）/ `control`（S0 无迁移对照）。
+- 开环复核组：`--scaling-load-mode open --scaling-open-rate <rate>`，固定总速率，GET:PUT:DELETE = 80:12:5:3（读 80%，rewrite 12%、新写 5%、删除 3%）；超过 `--max-in-flight` 的请求丢弃并计 `late`。每秒采样与汇总都记录 `issued`、`late`、`in_flight`。
+- 四类 cohort、按速率发放、局部 drain（只等本 transition 的写，读继续）、S1 后中间校验、最终全量校验、读己之写/删、发布后复读、按阶段与每秒指标、按原因的重试计数。
+- coordinator 工作步骤计时：`snapshot_copy_ms`、`changelog_replay_ms`、`pause_writes_ms`、`verify_ms`、`publish_ms`、`activation_ms`、`merge_proof_ms`、`catch_up_ms`，随 change 快照返回并写入 `work_steps_ms`。
+- **客户端观测的停写窗口**：变更期间每 5 ms 采样客户端的 `RangeBusy` 计数与成功写计数，写入 `<label>_transition.stop_window`：`first_range_busy_ms`、`last_range_busy_ms`、`first_write_ok_ms`、`busy_before_first_ok`、`observed_ms`、`poll_ms`。停写时长以客户端观测为准，不以 stage 边界为准。
+- **五个时间点**：`published_ms`、`complete_ms`、`full_rf_seconds`（`Complete` 之后到目标 epoch 满 RF），配合 `events.jsonl` 的 `migration_phase_changed` 与 `work_steps_ms` 可还原开始、发布、激活、`Complete`、满 RF。
+- 100 万键规模：`--keys 1000000` 可直接运行，池、预载和校验按该规模计算。

+### 容量基线（开环组 60% 的依据）
+
+开环组的速率来自同配置实测容量，不是估值。容量用 `latency` 模式在开环组的同一配置下测得：10 节点、RF=3、`OwnerOnly`、1M 键、128 B、GET:PUT:DELETE = 80:15:5、`zipf:0.99`、in-flight 4096、`--max-dedup-bytes 268435456`：
+
+| 提供速率 ops/s | 实际速率 | late | 重试 | GET p50 | GET p99 | CPU 总和 |
+|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
+| 40,000 | 40,000 | 0 | 0 | 66 µs | 143 µs | 240% |
+| 60,000 | 60,000 | 0 | 0 | 63 µs | 222 µs | 340% |
+| 80,000 | 80,000 | 0 | 0 | 72 µs | 698 µs | 441% |
+| 90,000 | 90,000 | 0 | 0 | 86 µs | 1.0 ms | 498% |
+| 100,000 | 100,000 | 0 | 946 | 164 µs | 2.4 ms | 560% |

+100k 是最后一条零丢弃档位；同一配置的试探档显示 110k 起饱和（实际 92.6k、late 347k、GET p50 39.7 ms）。因此取 **C = 100,000 ops/s**，开环组目标总量 = 0.6×C = 60,000 ops/s。开环模式每成功写一次就做一次读己之写探针（写占 offered 的 20%），所以 offered rate 取 **50,000**，实际总请求约 60,000。

+回执预算是这组配置的一部分：1M 键预载后每节点已有约 95 MB 回执，默认 128 MB 预算下开环写速率会被回执背压拉低（同一档位实测只跑到 24.6k）；矩阵脚本的 open 组因此默认 `--max-dedup-bytes 268435456`，容量基线用同样的值。重试 946 是客户端内部重试，应用层错误为 0。

+### 局限
+
+- 共享桌面主机，桌面进程同时运行；本轮桌面负载更高（`loadavg` 约 5），绝对吞吐低于更早的 `d0b160f` 记录（主组 grow `complete_ms` 2772 vs 1855），重复运行的波动同样受它影响。
+- S3/S4/诊断/策略组各只有 1 次重复，只能作为量级参考，不能当作分布。
+- 开环组在 RF 修复窗口出现负载丢弃，说明“稳态容量 60%”在修复期并不成立；容量基线只在无迁移、无修复的稳态下测得。
+- 计划 §5 中列为可选的“原始 owner RPC 探针”没有做：阻塞时长以客户端观测的 `RangeBusy` 窗口和按阶段的写延迟报告，没有把传输与重试等待分开。原始 `results/` 只有本机，不作为共享基线。
+- 开环组的一次性写入池必须覆盖整个 transition，包括下一个 transition 开始前对上一个 transition 的延迟校验。这个校验在满载下很慢（1M 键约 43 s），所以开环组对主机负载非常敏感：本轮在忙的主机上 3 次都被判 invalid。100k 键下池窗口只允许数千 ops/s（低于容量的 10%）。它的 post 窗口是 5 s（主组 10 s），以便池覆盖整个 transition。
+- 统计功效：每次运行零失败不能推出失败率上界；可用性只报告观察值（本轮闭环运行 0 失败）。

+## 1. 实验要回答的问题
+
+在持续混合读写流量下：
+
+1. **正确性**：扩容、缩容期间成功的写入、改写、删除，在迁移后是否仍然成立？读是否出现丢键、旧值、已删键复活？
+2. **可用性**：迁移期间 GET、PUT、DELETE 的失败率、超期率和 `RangeBusy` 拒绝分别出现在哪个阶段？
+3. **延迟**：迁移各工作步骤（快照复制、changelog 回放、切写、校验、发布、RF 修复）对读/写尾延迟的影响。
+4. **重试来源**：客户端重试由哪些应用层错误码、gRPC 状态、连接失败或拓扑刷新触发，集中在哪个阶段。
+5. **迁移代价**：各阶段与工作步骤耗时、迁移键/区间数量、发布到完整 RF 的时间、被移除节点退出时间。
+
+与现有 `correctness` 模式的区别：后者只对“会迁移的键”做一次性改写/删除，**没有持续 GET 负载，也没有负载中的延迟、错误和按阶段统计**。
