+async fn start_cluster(directory: &std::path::Path, initial: usize, peak: usize) -> Cluster {
+    let ports = unused_ports(peak + 1);
+    let endpoint = format!("http://127.0.0.1:{}", ports[0]);
+    let members: Vec<_> = (1..=peak)
+        .map(|index| (format!("node-{index}"), ports[index]))
+        .collect();
+    let coordinator = spawn_process(&coordinator_arguments(
+        ports[0],
+        &directory.join("coordinator.redb"),
+        &members[..initial],
+    ));
+    wait_for_listener(ports[0]);
+    let client = connect_eventually(&endpoint).await;
+    let mut nodes = Vec::new();
+    for (node_id, port) in &members[..initial] {
+        nodes.push(spawn_process(&[
+            "node".into(),
+            "--id".into(),
+            node_id.clone(),
+            "--listen".into(),
+            format!("127.0.0.1:{port}"),
+            "--coordinator".into(),
+            endpoint.clone(),
+        ]));
+    }
+    for (_, port) in &members[..initial] {
+        wait_for_listener(*port);
+    }
+    wait_for_full_rf(&endpoint, 1, 3).await;
+    Cluster {
+        endpoint,
+        ports,
+        members,
+        _coordinator: coordinator,
+        nodes,
+        client,
+    }
+}

+async fn preload(client: &HashringClient, key: u64, value: &[u8], entries: &Mutex<Vec<Entry>>) {
+    let invoked = Instant::now();
+    let invoked_unix_ms = unix_ms_now();
+    let epoch = client.epoch().await;
+    let output = client
+        .put(key.to_be_bytes().to_vec(), value.to_vec())
+        .await
+        .unwrap();
+    let completed = Instant::now();
+    entries.lock().await.push(Entry::Mutation(Mutation {
+        client: 0,
+        sequence: 0,
+        key,
+        kind: MutationKind::Put(value.to_vec()),
+        version: output.version,
+        invoked,
+        completed,
+        invoked_unix_ms,
+        completed_unix_ms: unix_ms_now(),
+        topology_epoch: epoch,
+    }));
+}
+
+async fn run_phase(
+    endpoint: &str,
+    keys: &[u64],
+    entries: Arc<Mutex<Vec<Entry>>>,
+    id: Arc<AtomicU64>,
+    label: &'static str,
+) {
+    let barrier = Arc::new(Barrier::new(CLIENTS));
+    let mut handles = Vec::new();
+    for client_id in 0..CLIENTS {
+        let endpoint = endpoint.to_owned();
+        let keys = keys.to_vec();
+        let entries = Arc::clone(&entries);
+        let barrier = Arc::clone(&barrier);
+        let id = Arc::clone(&id);
+        handles.push(tokio::spawn(async move {
+            let client = HashringClient::connect(endpoint, Duration::from_secs(30))
+                .await
+                .unwrap();
+            barrier.wait().await;
+            for step in 0..OPERATIONS_PER_CLIENT {
+                let key = keys[(step as usize + client_id) % keys.len()];
+                let operation = (step * 7 + client_id as u64 * 3) % 10;
+                let invoked = Instant::now();
+                let invoked_unix_ms = unix_ms_now();
+                let epoch = client.epoch().await;
+                match operation {
+                    0..=3 => {
+                        let value = format!("{label}-client{client_id}-step{step}").into_bytes();
+                        let output = client
+                            .put(key.to_be_bytes().to_vec(), value.clone())
+                            .await
+                            .unwrap();
+                        let completed = Instant::now();
+                        entries.lock().await.push(Entry::Mutation(Mutation {
+                            client: client_id,
+                            sequence: id.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed),
+                            key,
+                            kind: MutationKind::Put(value),
+                            version: output.version,
+                            invoked,
+                            completed,
+                            invoked_unix_ms,
+                            completed_unix_ms: unix_ms_now(),
+                            topology_epoch: epoch,
+                        }));
+                    }
+                    4..=6 => {
+                        let observation = match client.get(key.to_be_bytes().to_vec()).await {
+                            Ok(output) => ReadObservation::Present {
+                                value: output.value,
+                                version: output.version,
+                            },
+                            Err(ClientError::Operation(failure))
+                                if failure.code == ErrorCode::NotFound =>
+                            {
+                                ReadObservation::Absent
+                            }
+                            Err(error) => {
+                                panic!(
+                                    "{label}: GET failed during a healthy history run: {error:?}"
+                                )
+                            }
+                        };
+                        let completed = Instant::now();
+                        entries.lock().await.push(Entry::Read(Read {
+                            client: client_id,
+                            sequence: id.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed),
+                            key,
+                            observation,
+                            invoked,
+                            completed,
+                            invoked_unix_ms,
+                            completed_unix_ms: unix_ms_now(),
+                            topology_epoch: epoch,
+                        }));
+                    }
+                    _ => {
+                        let output = client.delete(key.to_be_bytes().to_vec()).await.unwrap();
+                        let completed = Instant::now();
+                        entries.lock().await.push(Entry::Mutation(Mutation {
+                            client: client_id,
+                            sequence: id.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed),
+                            key,
+                            kind: MutationKind::Delete,
+                            version: output.version,
+                            invoked,
+                            completed,
+                            invoked_unix_ms,
+                            completed_unix_ms: unix_ms_now(),
+                            topology_epoch: epoch,
+                        }));
+                    }
+                }
+            }
+        }));
+    }
+    for handle in handles {
+        handle.await.unwrap();
+    }
+}

+fn check_all(entries: &[Entry], keys: &[u64], phase: &str) {
+    for &key in keys {
+        check_key_history(key, entries, phase);
+    }

+fn artifact_dir(name: &str) -> PathBuf {
+    let path = PathBuf::from(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"))
+        .join("target")

+/// Writes the recorded history next to the test binary, where a failed or
+/// successful run can be inspected after the temporary cluster is gone.
+fn write_history(name: &str, entries: &[Entry]) {
+    let version = |version: &RecordVersion| {
+        json!({
+            "topology_epoch": version.topology_epoch,
+            "owner_sequence": version.owner_sequence,
+            "owner_node_id": version.owner_node_id,
+        })
+    };
+    let lines: Vec<String> = entries
+        .iter()
+        .map(|entry| match entry {
+            Entry::Mutation(mutation) => {
+                let (kind, value) = match &mutation.kind {
+                    MutationKind::Put(value) => ("put", Some(hex::encode(value))),
+                    MutationKind::Delete => ("delete", None),
+                };
+                json!({
+                    "kind": kind,
+                    "key": mutation.key,
+                    "value_hex": value,
+                    "client": mutation.client,
+                    "sequence": mutation.sequence,
+                    "version": version(&mutation.version),
+                    "invoked_unix_ms": mutation.invoked_unix_ms,
+                    "completed_unix_ms": mutation.completed_unix_ms,
+                    "topology_epoch": mutation.topology_epoch,
+                })
+                .to_string()
+            }
+            Entry::Read(read) => {
+                let observation = match &read.observation {
+                    ReadObservation::Present {
+                        value,
+                        version: observed,
+                    } => json!({
+                        "state": "present",
+                        "value_hex": hex::encode(value),
+                        "version": version(observed),
+                    }),
+                    ReadObservation::Absent => json!({ "state": "absent" }),
+                };
+                json!({
+                    "kind": "get",
+                    "key": read.key,
+                    "client": read.client,
+                    "sequence": read.sequence,
+                    "observation": observation,
+                    "invoked_unix_ms": read.invoked_unix_ms,
+                    "completed_unix_ms": read.completed_unix_ms,
+                    "topology_epoch": read.topology_epoch,
+                })
+                .to_string()
+            }
+        })
+        .collect();
+    let path = artifact_dir(name).join("history.jsonl");
+    fs::write(&path, lines.join("\n") + "\n").expect("writing the recorded history");
+    eprintln!("same-key history written to {}", path.display());
+}

+#[test]
+fn checker_respects_read_to_read_real_time() {
+    let base = Instant::now();
+    let at = |ms| base + Duration::from_millis(ms);
+    let version = |sequence| RecordVersion {
+        topology_epoch: 1,
+        owner_sequence: sequence,
+        owner_node_id: "node-1".into(),
+    };
+    let put = |sequence, value: &[u8], start, end| {
+        Entry::Mutation(Mutation {
+            client: 0,
+            sequence,
+            key: 7,
+            kind: MutationKind::Put(value.to_vec()),
+            version: version(sequence),
+            invoked: at(start),
+            completed: at(end),
+            invoked_unix_ms: 0,
+            completed_unix_ms: 0,
+            topology_epoch: 1,
+        })
+    };
+    let read = |observation, start, end| {
+        Entry::Read(Read {
+            client: 1,
+            sequence: start,
+            key: 7,
+            observation,
+            invoked: at(start),
+            completed: at(end),
+            invoked_unix_ms: 0,
+            completed_unix_ms: 0,
+            topology_epoch: 1,
+        })
+    };
+    let present = |value: &[u8], sequence| ReadObservation::Present {
+        value: value.to_vec(),
+        version: version(sequence),
+    };
+    let history = vec![
+        put(1, b"A", 0, 1),
+        put(2, b"B", 2, 10),
+        read(present(b"B", 2), 3, 4),
+        read(present(b"A", 1), 5, 6),
+    ];
+    assert!(std::panic::catch_unwind(|| check_key_history(7, &history, "regression")).is_err());
+
+    // Overlapping reads may return B then A in completion order, because
+    // their serialization order is allowed to be A then B.
+    let mut overlapping = history[..3].to_vec();
+    overlapping.push(read(present(b"A", 1), 3, 6));
+    check_key_history(7, &overlapping, "overlap");
+
+    // Absence has multiple candidate prefixes: choosing the earliest legal
+    // one must still respect a previous read of B.
+    let mut deleted = history[..3].to_vec();
+    let mut deletion = match put(3, b"", 2, 10) {
+        Entry::Mutation(m) => m,
+        _ => unreachable!(),
+    };
+    deletion.kind = MutationKind::Delete;
+    deleted.push(Entry::Mutation(deletion));
+    deleted.push(read(ReadObservation::Absent, 5, 6));
+    check_key_history(7, &deleted, "delete");
+}

+// Keep every key in the final-state oracle, without paying for one network
+// round trip at a time. Bound the work just as the snapshot-restart test does.
+async fn assert_values(client: &HashringClient, keys: &[Vec<u8>], values: &[Vec<u8>]) {
+    assert_eq!(keys.len(), values.len());
+    let mut reads = tokio::task::JoinSet::new();
+    for (key, value) in keys.iter().zip(values) {
+        let client = client.clone();
+        let key = key.clone();
+        let value = value.clone();
+        reads.spawn(async move {
+            assert_eq!(client.get(key).await.unwrap().value, value);
+        });
+        if reads.len() >= 64 {
+            reads.join_next().await.unwrap().unwrap();
+        }
+    }
+    while let Some(result) = reads.join_next().await {
+        result.unwrap();
+    }
+}

+        "--id".into(),
+        "node-2".into(),
+        "--listen".into(),
+        format!("127.0.0.1:{}", ports[2]),
+        "--coordinator".into(),

+    let executor = client.clone();
+    let execution = tokio::spawn(async move {
+        executor
+            .execute_topology_change(&plan.change_id, plan.base_epoch, plan.target_topology.epoch)
+            .await

+        loop {
+            if client
+                .topology_change()
+                .await
+                .unwrap()

+    node_2.stop();

+    // about 0.6 s on a loaded 8-core laptop. At 500 ms every 5 s recovery tick
+    // reset the change at Verifying and it never completed. The outage itself
+    // does not need a short deadline: with node-2 down, the retry fails at once

+                .await
+                .unwrap()

+            {
+                break;

+        }

+    .expect("transient destination outage did not retain a recoverable change");

+        "node".into(),
+        "--id".into(),
+        "node-2".into(),
+        "--listen".into(),
+        format!("127.0.0.1:{}", ports[2]),
+        "--coordinator".into(),
+        endpoint.clone(),
+    ]);
+    wait_for_listener(ports[2]);

+        loop {
+            if client
+                .topology_change()
+                .await
+                .unwrap()
+                .is_some_and(|change| change.phase == MigrationPhase::Complete)
+            {
+                break;
+            }
+            tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(100)).await;
+        }
+    })

+//! End-to-end retries after a mutation's response is lost.
+//!
+//! The driver applies a mutation with a caller-chosen mutation ID, throws the
+//! successful response away, and then retries the same ID after a membership
+//! change or an owner promotion. The retry must return the original version
+//! and must not apply the mutation a second time.
+
+use std::{
+    fs,
+    path::Path,
+    time::{Duration, Instant},
+};
+
+use hashring_client::{ClientError, HashringClient};
+use hashring_core::{
+    migration::MigrationPhase,
+    proto::{Empty, RecordVersion, coordinator_client::CoordinatorClient},
+    topology::{Member, TopologySnapshot, WriteAckPolicy},
+};
+
+use super::{
+    Process, coordinator_arguments, process_test_lock, spawn_process, unused_ports,
+    wait_for_full_rf, wait_for_listener,
+};
+
+struct Cluster {
+    endpoint: String,
+    ports: Vec<u16>,
+    members: Vec<(String, u16)>,
+    _coordinator: Process,
+    nodes: Vec<Process>,
+}
+
+impl Cluster {
+    fn spare(&self, initial: usize) -> Member {
+        let (node_id, _) = &self.members[initial];
+        Member {
+            node_id: node_id.clone(),
+            endpoint: format!("http://127.0.0.1:{}", self.ports[initial + 1]),
+        }
+    }
+
+    fn member_list(&self, prefix: usize) -> Vec<Member> {
+        self.members[..prefix]
+            .iter()
+            .map(|(node_id, port)| Member {
+                node_id: node_id.clone(),
+                endpoint: format!("http://127.0.0.1:{port}"),
+            })
+            .collect()
+    }
+}
+
+/// Everything the test learned about one logical request.
+#[derive(Clone, Debug, serde::Serialize)]
+struct RequestTrace {
+    logical_id: String,
+    key: u64,
+    operation: &'static str,
+    mutation_id: String,
+    first_attempt_version: Option<String>,
+    retry_epoch: u64,
+    retry_version: Option<String>,
+    outcome: String,
+}
+
+fn version_string(version: &RecordVersion) -> String {
+    format!(
+        "epoch={} sequence={} owner={}",
+        version.topology_epoch, version.owner_sequence, version.owner_node_id
+    )
+}
+
+fn artifact_dir(name: &str) -> std::path::PathBuf {
+    let path = std::path::Path::new(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"))
+        .join("target")
+        .join("test-artifacts")
+        .join(format!("{name}-{}", std::process::id()));
+    fs::create_dir_all(&path).expect("creating the test artifact directory");
+    path
+}
+
+fn write_trace(directory: &Path, traces: &[RequestTrace]) {
+    let body = traces
+        .iter()
+        .map(|trace| serde_json::to_string(trace).expect("trace serializes"))
+        .collect::<Vec<_>>()
+        .join("\n");
+    fs::write(directory.join("retry-trace.jsonl"), body + "\n").unwrap();
+}
+
+async fn start_cluster(directory: &Path, initial_nodes: usize, peak_nodes: usize) -> Cluster {
+    let ports = unused_ports(peak_nodes + 1);
+    let endpoint = format!("http://127.0.0.1:{}", ports[0]);
+    let members: Vec<_> = (1..=peak_nodes)
+        .map(|index| (format!("node-{index}"), ports[index]))
+        .collect();
+    let coordinator = spawn_process(&coordinator_arguments(
+        ports[0],
+        &directory.join("coordinator.redb"),
+        &members[..initial_nodes],
+    ));
+    wait_for_listener(ports[0]);
+    let mut nodes = Vec::new();
+    for (node_id, port) in &members[..initial_nodes] {
+        nodes.push(spawn_process(&[
+            "node".into(),
+            "--id".into(),
+            node_id.clone(),
+            "--listen".into(),
+            format!("127.0.0.1:{port}"),
+            "--coordinator".into(),
+            endpoint.clone(),
+        ]));
+    }
+    for (_, port) in &members[..initial_nodes] {
+        wait_for_listener(*port);
+    }
+    wait_for_full_rf(&endpoint, 1, 3).await;
+    Cluster {
+        endpoint,
+        ports,
+        members,
+        _coordinator: coordinator,
+        nodes,
+    }
+}
+
+async fn wait_for_caught_up_followers(endpoint: &str, epoch: u64) {
+    let deadline = Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(30);
+    loop {
+        let mut admin = CoordinatorClient::connect(endpoint.to_owned())
+            .await
+            .unwrap();
+        let status = admin
+            .get_replica_status(Empty {})
+            .await
+            .unwrap()
+            .into_inner();
+        if status.topology_epoch == epoch
+            && !status.ranges.is_empty()
+            && status.ranges.iter().all(|range| {
+                range.followers.iter().all(|follower| {
+                    follower.admitted
+                        && follower.lag_known
+                        && follower.stream_head == follower.stream_cursor
+                })
+            })
+        {
+            return;
+        }
+        assert!(
+            Instant::now() < deadline,
+            "followers did not catch up at epoch {epoch}: {status:?}"
+        );
+        tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(100)).await;
+    }
+}
+
+fn moving_key(base: &TopologySnapshot, target: &TopologySnapshot, start: u64) -> u64 {
+    (start..start + 100_000)
+        .find(|key| {
+            let key = key.to_be_bytes();
+            base.owner(&key).unwrap().node_id != target.owner(&key).unwrap().node_id
+        })
+        .expect("a scale-out must move at least one key")
+}

+#[tokio::test]

+    let client = HashringClient::connect(&cluster.endpoint, Duration::from_secs(30))
+        .await
+        .unwrap();
+
+    let base = client.refresh_topology().await.unwrap();

+    let spare = cluster.spare(3);
+    target.push(spare.clone());
+    let change = client.begin_topology_change(target).await.unwrap();
+    let put_key = moving_key(&base, &change.target_topology, 0);
+    let delete_key = moving_key(&base, &change.target_topology, put_key + 1);
+    assert_ne!(put_key, delete_key);
+
+    let put_id = "response-loss-migration-put";
+    let put_value = b"lost-put-value".to_vec();
+    // The response to this successful write is intentionally discarded. The
+    // write is applied, but the caller only knows the mutation ID.
+    let first_put = client
+        .put_with_mutation_id(put_key.to_be_bytes().to_vec(), put_value.clone(), put_id)
+        .await
+        .unwrap();
+    client
+        .put(delete_key.to_be_bytes().to_vec(), b"before-delete".to_vec())
+        .await
+        .unwrap();
+    let delete_id = "response-loss-migration-delete";

+        .delete_with_mutation_id(delete_key.to_be_bytes().to_vec(), delete_id)

+#[tokio::test]
+async fn response_loss_retry_after_owner_promotion_reuses_result_and_keeps_newer_value() {
+    let _guard = process_test_lock().lock().await;
+    let directory = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
+    let mut cluster = start_cluster(directory.path(), 3, 3).await;
+    let client = HashringClient::connect(&cluster.endpoint, Duration::from_secs(30))
+        .await
+        .unwrap();
+
+    let policy = client
+        .begin_write_policy_change(WriteAckPolicy::FirstSuccessor)
+        .await
+        .unwrap();
+    let applied = client
+        .execute_topology_change(
+            &policy.change_id,
+            policy.base_epoch,
+            policy.target_topology.epoch,
+        )
+        .await
+        .unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(applied.phase, MigrationPhase::Complete);
+    wait_for_caught_up_followers(&cluster.endpoint, applied.target_topology.epoch).await;
+
+    let topology = client.refresh_topology().await.unwrap();
+    let pick = |start: u64| {
+        (start..start + 100_000)
+            .map(|key| key.to_be_bytes().to_vec())
+            .find(|key| {
+                topology
+                    .replica_node_ids_for_token(topology.key_token(key))
+                    .unwrap()
+                    .starts_with(&["node-1", "node-2"])
+            })
+            .expect("test needs a range owned by node-1 with node-2 as first successor")
+    };
+    let put_key = pick(0);
+    let delete_key = pick(1);
+    assert_ne!(put_key, delete_key);
+    let put_key_number = u64::from_be_bytes(put_key.clone().try_into().unwrap());
+    let delete_key_number = u64::from_be_bytes(delete_key.clone().try_into().unwrap());
+
+    let put_id = "response-loss-promotion-put";
+    let put_value = b"lost-before-promotion".to_vec();
+    let first_put = client
+        .put_with_mutation_id(put_key.clone(), put_value.clone(), put_id)
+        .await
+        .unwrap();
+    client
+        .put(delete_key.clone(), b"before-promotion-delete".to_vec())
+        .await
+        .unwrap();
+    let delete_id = "response-loss-promotion-delete";
+    let first_delete = client
+        .delete_with_mutation_id(delete_key.clone(), delete_id)
+        .await
+        .unwrap();
+    // Both mutations and their receipts must be on node-2 before it is
+    // promoted, so this test checks deduplication across the promotion and
+    // not a permitted FirstSuccessor tail loss.
+    wait_for_caught_up_followers(&cluster.endpoint, applied.target_topology.epoch).await;
+
+    cluster.nodes[0].stop();
+    let promoted = tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(30), async {
+        loop {
+            let current = client.refresh_topology().await.unwrap();
+            if current.epoch > topology.epoch
+                && current
+                    .members
+                    .iter()
+                    .all(|member| member.node_id != "node-1")
+            {
+                break current;
+            }
+            tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(100)).await;
+        }
+    })
+    .await
+    .expect("the failed owner was not removed");
+    assert_eq!(promoted.owner(&put_key).unwrap().node_id, "node-2");
+    assert_eq!(promoted.owner(&delete_key).unwrap().node_id, "node-2");
+
+    let retried_put = client
+        .put_with_mutation_id(put_key.clone(), put_value.clone(), put_id)
+        .await
+        .unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(retried_put.version, first_put.version);
+    let read = client.get(put_key.clone()).await.unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(read.value, put_value);
+    assert_eq!(read.version, first_put.version);
+
+    let newer = client
+        .put(put_key.clone(), b"newer-after-promotion".to_vec())
+        .await
+        .unwrap();
+    let old_retry = client
+        .put_with_mutation_id(put_key.clone(), put_value, put_id)
+        .await
+        .unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(old_retry.version, first_put.version);
+    let read = client.get(put_key.clone()).await.unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(read.value, b"newer-after-promotion");
+    assert_eq!(read.version, newer.version);
+
+    let retried_delete = client
+        .delete_with_mutation_id(delete_key.clone(), delete_id)
+        .await
+        .unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(retried_delete.version, first_delete.version);
+    match client.get(delete_key.clone()).await {
+        Err(ClientError::Operation(failure)) => {
+            assert_eq!(failure.code, hashring_core::proto::ErrorCode::NotFound)
+        }
+        Ok(output) => panic!("deleted key read back as {:?}", output.value),
+        Err(other) => panic!("unexpected read result: {other:?}"),
+    }
+    let replacement = client
+        .put(delete_key.clone(), b"after-promoted-delete".to_vec())
+        .await
+        .unwrap();
+    let old_delete_retry = client
+        .delete_with_mutation_id(delete_key.clone(), delete_id)
+        .await
+        .unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(old_delete_retry.version, first_delete.version);
+    let read = client.get(delete_key.clone()).await.unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(read.value, b"after-promoted-delete");
+    assert_eq!(read.version, replacement.version);
+
+    let traces = vec![
+        RequestTrace {
+            logical_id: "promotion-put".into(),
+            key: put_key_number,
+            operation: "put",
+            mutation_id: put_id.into(),
+            first_attempt_version: Some(version_string(&first_put.version)),
+            retry_epoch: promoted.epoch,
+            retry_version: Some(version_string(&retried_put.version)),
+            outcome: "original result returned after promotion".into(),
+        },
+        RequestTrace {
+            logical_id: "promotion-delete".into(),
+            key: delete_key_number,
+            operation: "delete",
+            mutation_id: delete_id.into(),
+            first_attempt_version: Some(version_string(&first_delete.version)),
+            retry_epoch: promoted.epoch,
+            retry_version: Some(version_string(&retried_delete.version)),
+            outcome: "original result returned after promotion".into(),
+        },
+    ];
+    write_trace(&artifact_dir("retry-promotion"), &traces);
+}

-/// One `SCAN` step: the next cursor and the keys it returned. A step that
-/// answers `TRYAGAIN` is sent again with the same cursor, as a client would.
-async fn scan_step(
-    connection: &mut redis::aio::MultiplexedConnection,
-    cursor: u64,
-    options: &[&str],
-) -> (u64, Vec<String>) {
-    loop {
-        let mut command = redis::cmd("SCAN");
-        command.arg(cursor.to_string());
-        for option in options {
-            command.arg(*option);
-        }
-        match command
-            .query_async::<(String, Vec<String>)>(&mut *connection)
-            .await
-        {
-            Ok((next, keys)) => return (next.parse().expect("a numeric cursor"), keys),
-            Err(error) if error.code() == Some("TRYAGAIN") => continue,
-            Err(error) => panic!("SCAN failed: {error}"),
-        }
-    }
-}

-) -> Vec<String> {

-/// Sends one inline command over a raw socket and reads whatever comes back
-/// before the gateway stops writing, for checks the client library would hide.
-async fn raw_exchange(port: u16, request: &[u8]) -> Vec<u8> {
-    use tokio::io::{AsyncReadExt, AsyncWriteExt};
-    let mut socket = tokio::net::TcpStream::connect(("127.0.0.1", port))
-        .await
-        .unwrap();
-    socket.write_all(request).await.unwrap();
-    let mut answer = Vec::new();
-    let mut chunk = [0_u8; 4096];
-    loop {
-        match tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_millis(500), socket.read(&mut chunk)).await {
-            Ok(Ok(0)) | Err(_) => return answer,
-            Ok(Ok(read)) => answer.extend_from_slice(&chunk[..read]),
-            Ok(Err(error)) => panic!("{error}"),
-        }
-    }
-}

+//! The Redis gateway against a real cluster and a real Redis client.
+//!
+//! Everything here goes through a TCP socket and the `redis` crate, so what it
+//! proves is that an unmodified client library can drive the gateway: the
+//! handshake it sends on connect, the commands it reaches for, and RESP3
+//! negotiation all have to work for `redis-cli`, Jedis, Lettuce and go-redis to
+//! work at all.

+use std::{collections::HashMap, time::Duration};

+use hashring_core::topology::Member;

+#[path = "support/redis_gateway.rs"]
+pub mod gateway_support;
+use gateway_support::*;

+/// Every key of a cluster that is spread over more than one owner, so a
+/// multi-key command has to reach more than one node.
+fn keys_owned_by_different_nodes(
+    topology: &hashring_core::topology::TopologySnapshot,
+) -> Vec<String> {
+    let mut per_node = std::collections::HashMap::new();
+    for index in 0..10_000 {
+        let key = format!("fan-out-{index}");
+        let owner = topology.owner(key.as_bytes()).unwrap().node_id.clone();
+        per_node.entry(owner).or_insert_with(Vec::new).push(key);
+        if per_node.values().all(|keys| keys.len() > 4) {
+            break;
+        }
+    }
+    per_node.into_values().take(2).flatten().collect::<Vec<_>>()
+}

+/// The remaining TTL of a key, as a client sees it: -1 for a key that never
+/// expires and -2 for one that is not there.
+async fn ttl(connection: &mut redis::aio::MultiplexedConnection, key: &str) -> i64 {
+    redis::cmd("TTL")
+        .arg(key)
+        .query_async(connection)
+        .await
+        .unwrap()
+}

+    let directory = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
+    let cluster = Cluster::start(&directory.path().join("coordinator.redb"), None);
+    let mut connection = cluster.client().await;
+
+    // Getting here is itself the handshake result: the client connected,
+    // selected its database and identified itself, and the gateway answered.
+    let pong: String = redis::cmd("PING")
+        .query_async(&mut connection)
+        .await
+        .unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(pong, "PONG");

+    let _: () = redis::cmd("SET")

+        .query_async(&mut connection)
+        .await
+        .unwrap();
+    let value: String = redis::cmd("GET")
+        .arg("greeting")
+        .query_async(&mut connection)
+        .await
+        .unwrap();

+    let missing: Option<String> = redis::cmd("GET")
+        .arg("absent")
+        .query_async(&mut connection)

+        .unwrap();

+/// One `SCAN` step: the next cursor and the keys it returned. A step that
+/// answers `TRYAGAIN` is sent again with the same cursor, as a client would.
+async fn scan_step(
+    connection: &mut redis::aio::MultiplexedConnection,
+    cursor: u64,
+    options: &[&str],
+) -> (u64, Vec<String>) {
+    loop {
+        let mut command = redis::cmd("SCAN");
+        command.arg(cursor.to_string());
+        for option in options {
+            command.arg(*option);
+        }
+        match command
+            .query_async::<(String, Vec<String>)>(&mut *connection)
+            .await
+        {
+            Ok((next, keys)) => return (next.parse().expect("a numeric cursor"), keys),
+            Err(error) if error.code() == Some("TRYAGAIN") => continue,
+            Err(error) => panic!("SCAN failed: {error}"),
+        }
+    }
+}

+/// A whole scan from cursor 0 back to 0, sorted, checking that no key came
+/// back twice.
+async fn full_scan(
+    connection: &mut redis::aio::MultiplexedConnection,
+    options: &[&str],
+) -> Vec<String> {
+    let mut cursor = 0;
+    let mut keys = Vec::new();
+    for _ in 0..100_000 {
+        let (next, step) = scan_step(connection, cursor, options).await;
+        keys.extend(step);
+        if next == 0 {
+            let unique: std::collections::HashSet<_> = keys.iter().collect();
+            assert_eq!(unique.len(), keys.len(), "a scan returned a key twice");
+            keys.sort();
+            return keys;
+        }
+        cursor = next;
+    }
+    panic!("the scan never finished");
+}

+/// Sends one inline command over a raw socket and reads whatever comes back
+/// before the gateway stops writing, for checks the client library would hide.
+async fn raw_exchange(port: u16, request: &[u8]) -> Vec<u8> {
+    use tokio::io::{AsyncReadExt, AsyncWriteExt};
+    let mut socket = tokio::net::TcpStream::connect(("127.0.0.1", port))
+        .await
+        .unwrap();
+    socket.write_all(request).await.unwrap();
+    let mut answer = Vec::new();
+    let mut chunk = [0_u8; 4096];
+    loop {
+        match tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_millis(500), socket.read(&mut chunk)).await {
+            Ok(Ok(0)) | Err(_) => return answer,
+            Ok(Ok(read)) => answer.extend_from_slice(&chunk[..read]),
+            Ok(Err(error)) => panic!("{error}"),
+        }
+    }
+}

+#[tokio::test]
+async fn options_and_edge_cases_answer_the_way_redis_does() {
+    let _guard = test_lock().lock().await;
+    let directory = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
+    let cluster = Cluster::start(&directory.path().join("coordinator.redb"), None);
+    let mut connection = cluster.client().await;
+    let now_secs = std::time::SystemTime::now()
+        .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
+        .unwrap()
+        .as_secs();
+
+    // Each expiry option in its own unit.
+    let _: () = redis::cmd("SET")
+        .arg("px")
+        .arg("v")
+        .arg("PX")
+        .arg(5_000)
+        .query_async(&mut connection)
+        .await
+        .unwrap();
+    let pttl: i64 = redis::cmd("PTTL")
+        .arg("px")
+        .query_async(&mut connection)
+        .await
+        .unwrap();
+    assert!((1..=5_000).contains(&pttl), "PX 5000 left a PTTL of {pttl}");
+    let _: () = redis::cmd("SET")
+        .arg("exat")
+        .arg("v")
+        .arg("EXAT")
+        .arg(now_secs + 100)
+        .query_async(&mut connection)
+        .await
+        .unwrap();
+    assert!((98..=101).contains(&ttl(&mut connection, "exat").await));
+    let value: Option<String> = redis::cmd("GETEX")
+        .arg("exat")
+        .arg("PX")
+        .arg(2_000)
+        .query_async(&mut connection)
+        .await
+        .unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(value.as_deref(), Some("v"));
+    assert!((1..=2).contains(&ttl(&mut connection, "exat").await));
+
+    // An option with its operand missing is a syntax error on a connection
+    // that keeps working.
+    let error = redis::cmd("SET")
+        .arg("k")
+        .arg("v")
+        .arg("EX")
+        .query_async::<()>(&mut connection)
+        .await
+        .unwrap_err();
+    assert!(error.to_string().contains("syntax error"), "{error}");
+    let pong: String = redis::cmd("PING")
+        .query_async(&mut connection)
+        .await
+        .unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(pong, "PONG");
+
+    // `SET ... NX GET` answers with the value it did not replace.
+    let _: () = redis::cmd("SET")
+        .arg("nxget")
+        .arg("old")
+        .query_async(&mut connection)
+        .await
+        .unwrap();
+    let old: Option<String> = redis::cmd("SET")
+        .arg("nxget")
+        .arg("new")
+        .arg("NX")
+        .arg("GET")
+        .query_async(&mut connection)
+        .await
+        .unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(old.as_deref(), Some("old"));
+
+    // An empty `SETRANGE` creates nothing.
+    let length: i64 = redis::cmd("SETRANGE")
+        .arg("never")
+        .arg(100)
+        .arg("")
+        .query_async(&mut connection)
+        .await
+        .unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(length, 0);
+    let exists: i64 = redis::cmd("EXISTS")
+        .arg("never")
+        .query_async(&mut connection)
+        .await
+        .unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(exists, 0);
+
+    // A deadline in the past deletes; a key without one accepts `LT`.
+    let _: () = redis::cmd("SET")
+        .arg("gone")
+        .arg("v")
+        .query_async(&mut connection)
+        .await
+        .unwrap();
+    let expired: i64 = redis::cmd("EXPIRE")
+        .arg("gone")
+        .arg(-1)
+        .query_async(&mut connection)
+        .await
+        .unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(expired, 1);
+    assert_eq!(ttl(&mut connection, "gone").await, -2);
+    let _: () = redis::cmd("SET")
+        .arg("lt")
+        .arg("v")
+        .query_async(&mut connection)
+        .await
+        .unwrap();
+    let applied: i64 = redis::cmd("EXPIRE")
+        .arg("lt")
+        .arg(10)
+        .arg("LT")
+        .query_async(&mut connection)
+        .await
+        .unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(applied, 1);
+    assert!((9..=10).contains(&ttl(&mut connection, "lt").await));
+    let persisted: i64 = redis::cmd("PERSIST")
+        .arg("lt")
+        .query_async(&mut connection)
+        .await
+        .unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(persisted, 1);
+    assert_eq!(ttl(&mut connection, "lt").await, -1);
+
+    // The smallest integer is a result, not an overflow.
+    let _: () = redis::cmd("SET")
+        .arg("min")
+        .arg(i64::MIN + 1)
+        .query_async(&mut connection)
+        .await
+        .unwrap();
+    let min: i64 = redis::cmd("DECR")
+        .arg("min")
+        .query_async(&mut connection)
+        .await
+        .unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(min, i64::MIN);
+
+    // A key named twice in `MSET` takes its later value.
+    let _: () = redis::cmd("MSET")
+        .arg("twice")
+        .arg(1)
+        .arg("twice")
+        .arg(2)
+        .query_async(&mut connection)
+        .await
+        .unwrap();
+    let twice: String = redis::cmd("GET")
+        .arg("twice")
+        .query_async(&mut connection)
+        .await
+        .unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(twice, "2");
+
+    // A key the cluster refuses fails the whole multi-key command instead of
+    // counting as absent.
+    let oversized = "k".repeat(70 * 1024);
+    for command in ["DEL", "EXISTS"] {
+        let error = redis::cmd(command)
+            .arg("twice")
+            .arg(&oversized)
+            .query_async::<i64>(&mut connection)
+            .await
+            .unwrap_err();
+        assert!(error.to_string().contains("exceeds"), "{command}: {error}");
+    }
+}

+    )
+    .await;
+    assert_eq!(answer, b"+OK\r\n+OK\r\n+PONG\r\n");

+use std::{
+    path::Path,
+    process::{Child, Command, Stdio},
+    sync::OnceLock,
+    time::Duration,

+pub struct Process(Child);
+
+impl Process {
+    pub fn stop(&mut self) {
+        let _ = self.0.kill();
+        let _ = self.0.wait();
+    }
+}
+
+impl Drop for Process {
+    fn drop(&mut self) {
+        self.stop();
+    }

+/// One test at a time: every case starts a coordinator, three nodes and a
+/// gateway, and they are all reached over the loopback interface.
+pub fn test_lock() -> &'static tokio::sync::Mutex<()> {
+    static LOCK: OnceLock<tokio::sync::Mutex<()>> = OnceLock::new();
+    LOCK.get_or_init(|| tokio::sync::Mutex::new(()))
+}

+pub fn unused_ports(count: usize) -> Vec<u16> {
+    let listeners: Vec<_> = (0..count)
+        .map(|_| std::net::TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").unwrap())
+        .collect();
+    listeners
+        .iter()
+        .map(|listener| listener.local_addr().unwrap().port())
+        .collect()
+}
+
+pub fn spawn(arguments: &[String]) -> Process {
+    Process(
+        Command::new(env!("CARGO_BIN_EXE_hashring-rs"))
+            .args(arguments)
+            .stdin(Stdio::null())
+            .stdout(Stdio::null())
+            .stderr(Stdio::null())
+            .spawn()
+            .unwrap(),
+    )
+}
+
+pub fn wait_for_listener(port: u16) {
+    let address = format!("127.0.0.1:{port}").parse().unwrap();
+    for _ in 0..600 {
+        if std::net::TcpStream::connect_timeout(&address, Duration::from_millis(20)).is_ok() {
+            return;
+        }
+        std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(10));
+    }
+    panic!("nothing came up on port {port}");
+}

+/// A coordinator, three data nodes and a gateway, kept alive as long as the
+/// value is held.
+pub struct Cluster {
+    pub processes: Vec<Process>,
+    pub coordinator: String,
+    pub port: u16,
+    password: Option<String>,
+    gateway_command: &'static str,
+}
+
+impl Cluster {
+    pub fn start(state: &Path, password: Option<&str>) -> Self {
+        Self::start_with_gateway(state, password, "redis-gateway")
+    }
+
+    pub fn start_with_gateway(
+        state: &Path,
+        password: Option<&str>,
+        gateway_command: &'static str,
+    ) -> Self {
+        let ports = unused_ports(5);
+        let (coordinator_port, gateway_port) = (ports[0], ports[4]);
+        let members = vec![
+            ("node-1".to_owned(), ports[1]),
+            ("node-2".to_owned(), ports[2]),
+            ("node-3".to_owned(), ports[3]),
+        ];
+        let coordinator = format!("http://127.0.0.1:{coordinator_port}");
+        let mut bootstrap = vec![
+            "coordinator".to_owned(),
+            "--listen".to_owned(),
+            format!("127.0.0.1:{coordinator_port}"),
+            "--state".to_owned(),
+            state.display().to_string(),
+            "--virtual-nodes".to_owned(),
+            "32".to_owned(),
+            "--minimum-admitted-copies".to_owned(),
+            "1".to_owned(),
+            "--minimum-healthy-followers".to_owned(),
+            "0".to_owned(),
+        ];
+        for (node_id, port) in &members {
+            bootstrap.extend([
+                "--member".to_owned(),
+                format!("{node_id}=http://127.0.0.1:{port}"),
+            ]);
+        }
+        let mut processes = vec![spawn(&bootstrap)];
+        wait_for_listener(coordinator_port);
+        for (node_id, port) in &members {
+            processes.push(spawn(&[
+                "node".to_owned(),
+                "--id".to_owned(),
+                node_id.clone(),
+                "--listen".to_owned(),
+                format!("127.0.0.1:{port}"),
+                "--coordinator".to_owned(),
+                coordinator.clone(),
+            ]));
+            wait_for_listener(*port);
+        }
+        let mut gateway = vec![
+            gateway_command.to_owned(),
+            "--listen".to_owned(),
+            format!("127.0.0.1:{gateway_port}"),
+            "--coordinator".to_owned(),
+            coordinator.clone(),
+            // The first command may arrive before the gateway has a topology.
+            "--deadline-ms".to_owned(),
+            "10000".to_owned(),
+        ];
+        if let Some(password) = password {
+            gateway.extend(["--requirepass".to_owned(), password.to_owned()]);
+        }
+        processes.push(spawn(&gateway));
+        wait_for_listener(gateway_port);
+        Self {
+            processes,
+            coordinator,
+            port: gateway_port,
+            password: password.map(str::to_owned),
+            gateway_command,
+        }
+    }
+
+    pub fn url(&self, password: Option<&str>) -> String {
+        match password {
+            Some(password) => format!("redis://:{password}@127.0.0.1:{}", self.port),
+            None => format!("redis://127.0.0.1:{}", self.port),
+        }
+    }
+
+    /// Another gateway in front of the same cluster, as a second process
+    /// behind a load balancer would be. Its URL, and the process to keep alive.
+    pub fn second_gateway(&self) -> (Process, String) {
+        let port = unused_ports(1)[0];
+        let mut arguments = vec![
+            self.gateway_command.to_owned(),
+            "--listen".to_owned(),
+            format!("127.0.0.1:{port}"),
+            "--coordinator".to_owned(),
+            self.coordinator.clone(),
+            "--deadline-ms".to_owned(),
+            "10000".to_owned(),
+        ];
+        if let Some(password) = &self.password {
+            arguments.extend(["--requirepass".to_owned(), password.clone()]);
+        }
+        let process = spawn(&arguments);
+        wait_for_listener(port);
+        (process, format!("redis://127.0.0.1:{port}"))
+    }
+
+    pub fn authenticated_url(&self) -> String {
+        self.url(self.password.as_deref())
+    }
+
+    pub async fn try_connect(
+        &self,
+        url: &str,
+    ) -> redis::RedisResult<redis::aio::MultiplexedConnection> {
+        redis::Client::open(url.to_owned())?
+            .get_multiplexed_async_connection()
+            .await
+    }
+
+    pub async fn connect(&self, url: &str) -> redis::aio::MultiplexedConnection {
+        self.try_connect(url)
+            .await
+            .expect("a redis client could not connect to the gateway")
+    }
+
+    pub async fn client(&self) -> redis::aio::MultiplexedConnection {
+        self.connect(&self.authenticated_url()).await
+    }
+
+    pub async fn cluster_client(&self) -> HashringClient {
+        for _ in 0..100 {
+            if let Ok(client) =
+                HashringClient::connect(&self.coordinator, Duration::from_secs(2)).await
+            {

+        }
+        panic!("the coordinator never became ready");
+    }
